    _ ≤ E.length := List.toFinset_card_le E
    _ = 2 * L.length := by simp [E, List.length_flatMap, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem occurring_agent_has_filtered_initial_call{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (k : Fin m)
  (hocc : ∃ c ∈ S, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) :
  ∃ c ∈ List.filter (fun d : Call m => isInitialCall S d) S,
    c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k := by
  have hstrong :
      ∀ (S : List (Call m)), (∃ c ∈ S, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) →
        ∃ c ∈ S, (c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) ∧ isAgentInitialCall S k c = true := by
    intro S
    induction S with
    | nil =>
        simp
    | cons d T ih =>
        intro hocc'
        by_cases hd : d.1 = k ∨ d.2 = k
        · refine ⟨d, by simp, hd, ?_⟩
          simp [isAgentInitialCall, initial, hd]
        · have hoccT : ∃ c ∈ T, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k := by
            simpa [hd] using hocc'
          obtain ⟨c, hcT, hck, hcinit⟩ := ih hoccT
          refine ⟨c, List.mem_cons_of_mem d hcT, hck, ?_⟩
          simpa [isAgentInitialCall, initial, hd] using hcinit
  obtain ⟨c, hcS, hck, hcinit⟩ := hstrong S hocc
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hck⟩
  simp only [List.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨hcS, ?_⟩
  rcases hck with hck | hck
  · simp [isInitialCall, hck, hcinit]
  · simp [isInitialCall, hck, hcinit]

theorem occurring_agent_has_filtered_final_call{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (k : Fin m)
  (hocc : ∃ c ∈ S, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) :
  ∃ c ∈ List.filter (fun d : Call m => isFinalCall S d) S,
    c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k := by
  have hstrong : ∀ (S : List (Call m)),
      (∃ c ∈ S, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) →
        ∃ c ∈ S, (c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k) ∧ isAgentFinalCall S k c := by
    intro S hocc
    induction S using List.reverseRecOn with
    | nil =>
        simp at hocc
    | append_singleton d T ih =>
        by_cases hT : T.1 = k ∨ T.2 = k
        · refine ⟨T, by simp, hT, ?_⟩
          simp [isAgentFinalCall, final, hT]
        · have hd : ∃ c ∈ d, c.1 = k ∨ c.2 = k := by
            obtain ⟨c, hc, hck⟩ := hocc
            have hc' : c ∈ d ∨ c = T := by simpa using hc
            rcases hc' with hc | rfl
            · exact ⟨c, hc, hck⟩
            · exact (hT hck).elim
          obtain ⟨c, hcd, hck, hfinal⟩ := ih hd
          refine ⟨c, List.mem_append_left _ hcd, hck, ?_⟩
          simpa [isAgentFinalCall, final, hT] using hfinal
  obtain ⟨c, hcS, hck, hcfinal⟩ := hstrong S hocc
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hck⟩
  simp only [List.mem_filter, hcS, true_and]
  simp only [isFinalCall, decide_eq_true_eq]
  rcases hck with hck | hck
  · left
    simpa [hck] using hcfinal
  · right
    simpa [hck] using hcfinal

theorem pair_list_endpoint_nodup_cover_card_eq{α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
  (L : List (α × α))
  (hcover : ∀ a : α, ∃ c ∈ L, c.1 = a ∨ c.2 = a)
  (hnodup : (L.flatMap (fun c => [c.1, c.2])).Nodup) :
  Fintype.card α = 2 * L.length := by
  let E : List α := L.flatMap (fun c => [c.1, c.2])
  have hE : E.toFinset = Finset.univ := by
    ext a
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    rcases hcover a with ⟨c, hc, hca⟩
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton]
    rcases hca with hca | hca
    · exact Or.inl hca.symm
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hca.symm)
  calc
    Fintype.card α = (Finset.univ : Finset α).card := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ]
    _ = E.toFinset.card := by rw [hE]
    _ = E.length := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
    _ = 2 * L.length := by
      simp [E, List.length_flatMap, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem initial_endpoint_list_nodup_of_structural_facts{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m))
  (L : List (Call m))
  (hsub : ∀ c ∈ L, c ∈ S)
  (hL : L.Nodup)
  (hboth : ∀ c ∈ L,
    isAgentInitialCall S c.1 c = true ∧ isAgentInitialCall S c.2 c = true)
  (hne : ∀ c ∈ L, c.1 ≠ c.2) :
  (L.flatMap (fun c => [c.1, c.2])).Nodup := by
  induction L with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons c T ih =>
      have hcT : c ∉ T := hL.not_mem
      have hT : T.Nodup := hL.of_cons
      have hc_mem : c ∈ c :: T := by
        simp
      have hc1 := (hboth c hc_mem).1
      have hc2 := (hboth c hc_mem).2
      simp only [isAgentInitialCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc1 hc2
      have hmem_equiv (a : Fin m) :
          a ∈ T.flatMap (fun d => [d.1, d.2]) ↔
            ∃ d ∈ T, a = d.1 ∨ a = d.2 := by
        simp
      have hc1_not_tail : c.1 ∉ T.flatMap (fun d => [d.1, d.2]) := by
        intro ha
        obtain ⟨d, hdT, hcd⟩ := (hmem_equiv c.1).mp ha
        have hd_mem : d ∈ c :: T := by
          simp only [List.mem_cons]
          exact Or.inr hdT
        rcases hcd with hcd | hcd
        · have hd1 := (hboth d hd_mem).1
          simp only [isAgentInitialCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hd1
          rw [← hcd] at hd1
          have hEq : c = d := Option.some.inj (hc1.symm.trans hd1)
          apply hcT
          rw [hEq]
          exact hdT
        · have hd2 := (hboth d hd_mem).2
          simp only [isAgentInitialCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hd2
          rw [← hcd] at hd2
          have hEq : c = d := Option.some.inj (hc1.symm.trans hd2)
          apply hcT
          rw [hEq]
          exact hdT
      have hc2_not_tail : c.2 ∉ T.flatMap (fun d => [d.1, d.2]) := by
        intro ha
        obtain ⟨d, hdT, hcd⟩ := (hmem_equiv c.2).mp ha
        have hd_mem : d ∈ c :: T := by
          simp only [List.mem_cons]
          exact Or.inr hdT
        rcases hcd with hcd | hcd
        · have hd1 := (hboth d hd_mem).1
          simp only [isAgentInitialCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hd1
          rw [← hcd] at hd1
          have hEq : c = d := Option.some.inj (hc2.symm.trans hd1)
          apply hcT
          rw [hEq]
          exact hdT
        · have hd2 := (hboth d hd_mem).2
          simp only [isAgentInitialCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hd2
          rw [← hcd] at hd2
          have hEq : c = d := Option.some.inj (hc2.symm.trans hd2)
          apply hcT
          rw [hEq]
          exact hdT
      have hflatT : (T.flatMap (fun d => [d.1, d.2])).Nodup := by
        apply ih
        · intro d hd
          exact hsub d (by
            simp only [List.mem_cons]
            exact Or.inr hd)
        · exact hT
        · intro d hd
          exact hboth d (by
            simp only [List.mem_cons]
            exact Or.inr hd)
        · intro d hd
          exact hne d (by
            simp only [List.mem_cons]
            exact Or.inr hd)
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      apply List.Nodup.cons
      · intro ha
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at ha
        rcases ha with hcc | ha
        · exact (hne c hc_mem) hcc
        · exact hc1_not_tail ha
      · apply List.Nodup.cons
        · exact hc2_not_tail
        · exact hflatT

theorem noHo_repeated_call_occurrences_adjacent{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hno : noHo S)

  (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
  by_contra hne
  have hgap : (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) := by omega
  have hiprefix : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ (j : ℕ) - 1 := by omega
  have htake_i : S.take ((i : ℕ) + 1) = S.take (i : ℕ) ++ [S[i]] := by
    symm
    exact List.take_concat_get' S (i : ℕ) i.isLt
  have hprefix : S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1) =
      S.take ((i : ℕ) + 1) ++ (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).drop ((i : ℕ) + 1) := by
    calc
      S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1) =
          (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).take ((i : ℕ) + 1) ++
            (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).drop ((i : ℕ) + 1) :=
        (List.take_append_drop ((i : ℕ) + 1) (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1))).symm
      _ = S.take ((i : ℕ) + 1) ++
            (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).drop ((i : ℕ) + 1) := by
        rw [List.take_take, min_eq_left hiprefix]
  rcases hcall : S[i] with ⟨a, b⟩
  have hself_b : after (S.take (i : ℕ)) b b := by
    exact callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) (S.take (i : ℕ)) b b rfl
  have hab : makeCall (after (S.take (i : ℕ))) (a, b) a b := by
    simp [makeCall, hself_b]
  have hknows : after (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)) a b := by
    rw [hprefix, htake_i, hcall]
    simpa [after, makeCalls] using
      (callsIncreaseGossip
        (makeCall (after (S.take (i : ℕ))) (a, b))
        ((S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).drop ((i : ℕ) + 1)) a b hab)
  have hj := hno j
  rw [← heq, hcall] at hj
  exact hj.1 hknows

    have hfsnd : f e.snd = e := by
      simpa only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hsndmem
    constructor
    · have h := hfR e.fst
      rw [hffst] at h
      exact h
    · have h := hfR e.snd
      rw [hfsnd] at h
      exact h

theorem initial_final_filter_lower_bounds{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k) :
  m ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isInitialCall S c)).length ∧
  m ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ k : Fin m, ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := by
    intro k
    exact (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
  constructor
  · have h := (pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S
        (fun k c => isAgentInitialCall S k c = true)
        (fun k c => inferInstance) ?_ ?_).1
    · simpa [isInitialCall] using h
    · intro a
      have hs : (initial S a).isSome = true := by
        unfold initial
        rw [List.find?_isSome]
        rcases hex a with ⟨c, hc, hi⟩
        exact ⟨c, hc, by simpa using hi⟩
      cases hia : initial S a with
      | none => simp [hia] at hs
      | some e =>
          refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
          · unfold initial at hia
            exact List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hia
          · simp [isAgentInitialCall, hia]
    · intro a e hae
      have hia : initial S a = some e := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hae
      have hp : e.fst = a ∨ e.snd = a := by
        unfold initial at hia
        have hp' := List.find?_some hia
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hp'
      simpa [eq_comm] using hp
  · have h := (pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S
        (fun k c => isAgentFinalCall S k c = true)
        (fun k c => inferInstance) ?_ ?_).1
    · simpa [isFinalCall] using h
    · intro a
      have hs : (final S a).isSome = true := by
        unfold final
        rw [List.find?_isSome]
        rcases hex a with ⟨c, hc, hi⟩
        exact ⟨c, (List.mem_reverse).2 hc, by simpa using hi⟩
      cases hfa : final S a with
      | none => simp [hfa] at hs
      | some e =>
          refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
          · unfold final at hfa
            exact (List.mem_reverse).1 (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfa)
          · simp [isAgentFinalCall, hfa]
    · intro a e hae
      have hfa : final S a = some e := by
        simpa [isAgentFinalCall] using hae
      have hp : e.fst = a ∨ e.snd = a := by
        unfold final at hfa
        have hp' := List.find?_some hfa
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hp'
      simpa [eq_comm] using hp

theorem tight_initial_filter_forces_both_endpoints{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k)
  (htight : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isInitialCall S c)).length) :
  ∀ c ∈ S, isInitialCall S c = true →
    isAgentInitialCall S c.fst c = true ∧ isAgentInitialCall S c.snd c = true := by
  classical
  let R : Fin m → Call m → Prop := fun k c => isAgentInitialCall S k c = true
  have hcover : ∀ k, ∃ c ∈ S, R k c := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨d, hdS, hd⟩ := (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
    have hsome : (initial S k).isSome = true := by
      rw [initial, List.find?_isSome]
      exact ⟨d, hdS, by simpa using hd⟩
    cases hi : initial S k with
    | none => simp [hi] at hsome
    | some c =>
      refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply List.mem_of_find?_eq_some
        simpa [initial] using hi
      · simp [R, isAgentInitialCall, hi]
  have hendpoint : ∀ k c, R k c → k = c.fst ∨ k = c.snd := by
    intro k c hkc
    have hi : initial S k = some c := by
      simpa [R, isAgentInitialCall] using hkc
    have hp := List.find?_some (show S.find? (fun d => d.fst = k ∨ d.snd = k) = some c by simpa [initial] using hi)
    have hp' : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := of_decide_eq_true hp
    rcases hp' with hp | hp
    · exact Or.inl hp.symm
    · exact Or.inr hp.symm
  have hbound := pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S R (fun k c => inferInstance) hcover hendpoint
  have htightR : Fintype.card (Fin m) =
      2 * (S.filter (fun c => decide (R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c))).length := by
    simpa [R, isInitialCall, Bool.or_eq_true] using htight
  intro c hc hinit
  have hRor : R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c := by
    simpa [R, isInitialCall, Bool.or_eq_true] using hinit
  exact hbound.2 htightR c hc hRor

theorem tight_final_filter_forces_both_endpoints{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k)
  (htight : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length) :
  ∀ c ∈ S, isFinalCall S c = true →
    isAgentFinalCall S c.fst c = true ∧ isAgentFinalCall S c.snd c = true := by
  classical
  have hex (k : Fin m) : ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k :=
    (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
  let R : Fin m → Call m → Prop := fun k c => isAgentFinalCall S k c = true
  have hcover : ∀ k : Fin m, ∃ c ∈ S, R k c := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨d, hdS, hd⟩ := hex k
    have hdrev : d ∈ S.reverse := by simpa using hdS
    have hisSome : (S.reverse.find? (fun c => decide (c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k))).isSome = true :=
      List.find?_isSome.mpr ⟨d, hdrev, by simpa using hd⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hisSome
    refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have herev : e ∈ S.reverse := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some he
      simpa using herev
    · simp only [R, isAgentFinalCall, final, decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact he
  have hendpoint : ∀ k c, R k c → k = c.fst ∨ k = c.snd := by
    intro k c hk
    simp only [R, isAgentFinalCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hk
    have hp := List.find?_some hk
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
    exact hp.elim (fun h => Or.inl h.symm) (fun h => Or.inr h.symm)
  have hpair := pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S R (fun k c => inferInstance) hcover hendpoint
  have htight' : Fintype.card (Fin m) =
      2 * (S.filter (fun c => decide (R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c))).length := by
    simpa [R, isFinalCall] using htight
  intro c hc hfinal
  exact hpair.2 htight' c hc (by simpa [R, isFinalCall] using hfinal)

theorem call_mem_implies_mutual_knowledge_after{m : ℕ} (T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (hc : c ∈ T) :
  (after T) c.fst c.snd ∧ (after T) c.snd c.fst := by
  rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
  obtain ⟨xs, ys, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hc
  have haa : makeCalls (initialState m) xs a a := by
    apply callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) xs a a
    rfl
  have hbb : makeCalls (initialState m) xs b b := by
    apply callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) xs b b
    rfl
  have hab : makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b) a b := by
    simp [makeCall, hbb]
  have hba : makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b) b a := by
    by_cases h : b = a <;> simp [makeCall, h, haa]
  constructor
  · have h := callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b)) ys a b hab
    simpa [after, makeCalls] using h
  · have h := callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b)) ys b a hba
    simpa [after, makeCalls] using h

theorem noHo_repeated_call_indices_are_adjacent{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (i j : Fin S.length) (hij : i < j) (hsame : S.get i = S.get j) :
  (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
  have hle : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ (j : ℕ) := by omega
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · by_contra hnot
    have hgap : (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) := by omega
    have htake : (i : ℕ) < (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).length := by
      simp only [List.length_take]
      omega
    let i' : Fin (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).length := ⟨i, htake⟩
    have hmem' := List.get_mem (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)) i'
    have hget : (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).get i' = S.get i := by
      simp [i']
    have hmem : S.get i ∈ S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1) := by
      rw [← hget]
      exact hmem'
    have hk := call_mem_implies_mutual_knowledge_after
      (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)) (S.get i) hmem
    have hno := noHo_S j
    rw [hsame] at hk
    exact (hno.1 hk.1).elim
  · exact hle

theorem list_countP_eq_card_satisfying_indices{α : Type*} (l : List α) (p : α → Bool) :
  l.countP p = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l.length)).filter (fun i => p (l.get i) = true)).card := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
      have hcard := Fin.card_filter_univ_succ'
        (n := l.length)
        (fun i : Fin (l.length + 1) => p ((a :: l).get i) = true)

theorem agent_initial_and_final_participation_le_two{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S) (k : Fin m) (c : Call m)
  (hinit : isAgentInitialCall S k c = true)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true) :
  v S k ≤ 2 := by
  unfold isAgentInitialCall at hinit
  unfold isAgentFinalCall at hfinal
  unfold initial at hinit
  unfold final at hfinal
  unfold v
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hinit hfinal
  rw [← List.ofFn_get S] at hinit
  rw [List.find?_ofFn_eq_some] at hinit
  rcases hinit with ⟨hc, i, hi, hbefore⟩
  rw [← List.ofFn_get S.reverse] at hfinal
  rw [List.find?_ofFn_eq_some] at hfinal
  rcases hfinal with ⟨hc', r, hr, hrevbefore⟩
  have hrlen : (r : ℕ) < S.length := by simpa using r.isLt
  have hjbound : S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ) < S.length := by omega
  let j : Fin S.length := ⟨S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ), hjbound⟩
  have hj : S.get j = c := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact (List.get_reverse' S r hjbound).symm
  have hleft : ∀ q : Fin S.length,
      decide ((S.get q).1 = k ∨ (S.get q).2 = k) = true → i ≤ q := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hn
    exact hbefore q (lt_of_not_ge hn) hq
  have hright : ∀ q : Fin S.length,
      decide ((S.get q).1 = k ∨ (S.get q).2 = k) = true → q ≤ j := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hn
    have hjq : j < q := lt_of_not_ge hn
    change S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ) < (q : ℕ) at hjq
    let rq : Fin S.reverse.length :=
      ⟨S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ), by
        simp only [List.length_reverse]
        omega⟩
    have hrqlt : rq < r := by
      change S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ) < (r : ℕ)
      omega
    have hbackbound : S.length - 1 - (rq : ℕ) < S.length := by
      dsimp [rq]
      omega
    have hgetrq : S.reverse.get rq = S.get q := by
      rw [List.get_reverse' S rq hbackbound]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      change S.length - 1 - (S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ)) = (q : ℕ)
      omega
    apply hrevbefore rq hrqlt
    rw [hgetrq]
    exact hq
  have hiSat : decide ((S.get i).1 = k ∨ (S.get i).2 = k) = true := by
    rw [hi]
    exact hc
  have hilej : i ≤ j := hright i hiSat
  have hj_le : (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
    by_cases heq : i = j
    · subst j
      omega
    · have hlt : i < j := lt_of_le_of_ne hilej heq
      exact (noHo_repeated_call_indices_are_adjacent S noHo_S i j hlt (hi.trans hj.symm)).le
  rw [list_countP_eq_card_satisfying_indices]
  refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (Finset.card_le_two (a := i) (b := j))
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hsat := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
  have hiq := hleft q hsat
  have hqj := hright q hsat
  omega

theorem initial_final_filters_disjoint_of_exact_sum{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S))
  (S_len_lt : S.length ≤ 2 * m - 5) (noHo_S : noHo S)

    (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length) :

    intro k

    omega
  obtain ⟨hI, hF⟩ := initial_final_filter_lower_bounds S hpos
  have htI : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isInitialCall S c)).length := by
    omega
  have htF : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length := by
    omega
  intro c hc hboth
  obtain ⟨hic, hfc⟩ := hboth
  have hini := tight_initial_filter_forces_both_endpoints S hpos htI c hc hic
  have hfin := tight_final_filter_forces_both_endpoints S hpos htF c hc hfc
  have hle := agent_initial_and_final_participation_le_two S noHo_S c.fst c hini.1 hfin.1
  have hge := hdeg c.fst
  omega

theorem errFree_resultSet_values_match_distribution{n} {S : @Dist n} {σ : @Sequence n} (hσ : errFree σ) (oσ : maxOne σ)

      subst d
      apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
      | Caller => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inl ha
      | Callee => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inl ha
      | Other => exact False.elim (hrole hr)
    · have hd : d = S j :=
        errFree_resultSet_values_are_actual (⁻o) hfree_tail hc
      subst d
      apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
      | Caller => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inr hc
      | Callee => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inr hc
      | Other => exact False.elim (hrole hr)

theorem errFree_forceFalse_resultSet_normalization{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ) :
    resultSet i (forceFalseAt b S) ⟨σ, o⟩ =
      collapseValueAt b '' resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
  induction σ generalizing S i with
  | nil =>
      ext x
      rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
      by_cases h : i = b <;> simp [forceFalseAt, collapseValueAt, h]
  | cons C σ ih =>
      cases C with
      | normal a c =>
          have hfree' : errFree σ := by
            simpa [errFree] using hfree
          cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
          | Other =>
              unfold resultSet
              rw [hr]
              exact ih (⁻o) hfree'
          | Caller =>
              have hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) ≠ Role.Other := by
                simp [hr]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [ih (⁻o) hfree', ih (⁻o) hfree', Set.image_union]
          | Callee =>
              have hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) ≠ Role.Other := by
                simp [hr]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [ih (⁻o) hfree', ih (⁻o) hfree', Set.image_union]
      | fstE a e c =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree
      | sndE a c e =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree

theorem invert_at_eq_collapse_image_of_false_absent{n} {b : @Agent n} {A : Set (@Value n)}
    (h : (b, false) ∉ A) :
    invert b A = collapseValueAt b '' A := by
  unfold invert
  apply Set.image_congr
  intro x hx
  rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
  by_cases hj : j = b
  · subst j
    cases d
    · exact (h hx).elim
    · rfl
  · simp only [collapseValueAt, hj, ↓reduceIte]

theorem errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ) (hSb : S b = true) :
    invert b (resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩) =
      resultSet i (forceFalseAt b S) (eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩) := by
  have herase : eraseErrorsAt b σ = σ :=
    eraseErrorsAt_eq_self_of_errFree (b := b) hfree
  have hwrong : (b, false) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
    simpa only [hSb, Bool.not_true] using
      (errFree_has_no_wrong_values (S := S) (i := i) (b := b) o hfree)
  have hinv := invert_at_eq_collapse_image_of_false_absent hwrong
  have hnorm :=
    errFree_forceFalse_resultSet_normalization (S := S) (b := b) (i := i) o hfree
  have heraseO : eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩ = ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact herase
  rw [heraseO]
  exact hinv.trans hnorm.symm

theorem forceFalse_fstE_step_equi{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i a e c : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne (Call.fstE a e c :: σ))
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (hIH : ∀ j : @Agent n,
      (b, true) ∉ resultSet j S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ →
      equi j (S, ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩)
        (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩))
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩) :
    equi i (S, ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩)
      (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩) := by
  by_cases he : e = b
  · subst e
    cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.fstE a b c)
    · have hi : i = a := by simpa using hr
      subst i
      have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH a ha_abs
      have hceq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, contribSet, Call.pair] using hceq
    · have hrole : i ≠ a ∧ i = c := by simpa using hr
      rcases hrole with ⟨hia, hic⟩
      subst i
      have hfree : errFree σ := by simpa [maxOne] using o
      have hcontrib := errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet
        (S := S) (b := b) (i := a) (⁻o) hfree hSb
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH c hc_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, hia, contribSet, Call.pair] using hcontrib
    · have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        simpa [resultSet, hr] using habs
      have hrec := hIH i hi_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [roleOfIn] using hr.symm
        · simp [hr]
  · cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.fstE a e c)
    · have hi : i = a := by simpa using hr
      subst i
      have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH a ha_abs
      have hceq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, contribSet, Call.pair] using hceq
    · have hrole : i ≠ a ∧ i = c := by simpa using hr
      rcases hrole with ⟨hia, hic⟩
      subst i
      have htail : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH c htail
      have htaila : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hinv : (b, true) ∈ invert e (resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) :=
          (invert_preserves_other_agent_membership (d := true)
            (A := resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) he).2 hmem
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hinv])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have haeq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a htaila)
      have hinveq := congrArg (invert e) haeq
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, hia, contribSet, Call.pair] using hinveq
    · have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        simpa [resultSet, hr] using habs
      have hrec := hIH i hi_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact rfl
        · simp [hr]

theorem forceFalse_sndE_step_equi{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i a c e : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne (Call.sndE a c e :: σ))
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (hIH : ∀ j : @Agent n,
      (b, true) ∉ resultSet j S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ →
      equi j (S, ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩)
        (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩))
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩) :
    equi i (S, ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩)
      (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩) := by
  have hrecv_abs : (b, true) ∉ receivedSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.sndE a c e) := by
    intro hmem
    apply habs
    have hs := @actual_value_survives_one_call n S i b σ (Call.sndE a c e) o
      (by simpa only [hSb] using hmem)
    simpa only [hSb] using hs
  unfold equi
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt]
  · by_cases heb : e = b
    · subst e
      have hfree : errFree σ := by simpa [maxOne] using o
      unfold equiv
      simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, List.map_cons, eraseErrorAt,
        ↓reduceIte]
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.sndE a c b) with
      | Caller =>
          have hi : i = a := roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Caller_iff.mp hr
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ invert b (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hcontrib :=
            errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet (S := S) (b := b) (i := c)
              (⁻o) hfree hSb
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH a ha_abs)
          · simp [roleOfIn]
          · simpa [contribSet, Call.pair, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hcontrib
      | Callee =>
          rcases roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Callee_iff.mp hr with ⟨hia, hic⟩
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hsame_a := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a ha_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH c hc_abs)
          · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
          · simpa [contribSet, Call.pair, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hsame_a
      | Other =>
          have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH i hi_abs)
          · simpa [roleOfIn] using hr.symm
          · simp only
    · unfold equiv
      simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, List.map_cons, heb, ↓reduceIte]
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.sndE a c e) with
      | Caller =>
          have hi : i = a := roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Caller_iff.mp hr
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ invert e (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hcinv_abs : (b, true) ∉ invert e (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            apply hcinv_abs
            exact (invert_preserves_other_agent_membership (d := true) heb).mpr hm
          have hsame_c := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH a ha_abs)
          · simp [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn]
          · simpa [contribSet, eraseErrorAt, heb, Call.pair,
              eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using congrArg (invert e) hsame_c
      | Callee =>
          rcases roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Callee_iff.mp hr with ⟨hia, hic⟩
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hsame_a := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a ha_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH c hc_abs)
          · simp [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn, hia]
          · simpa [contribSet, eraseErrorAt, heb, Call.pair,
              eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hsame_a
      | Other =>
          have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH i hi_abs)
          · simpa [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn] using hr.symm
          · simp only

theorem forceFalse_eraseErrors_equi_of_true_absent{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @OSequence n}
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S σ) :
    equi i (S, σ) (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b σ) := by
  rcases σ with ⟨σ, o⟩
  induction σ generalizing S i with
  | nil =>
      have hib : i ≠ b := by
        intro h
        subst i
        simp [resultSet, hSb] at habs
      unfold equi
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [OSequence.length, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt]
      · simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
        unfold eraseErrorsOSequence eraseErrorsAt
        simp only [List.map_nil]
        rw [equiv_nil]
        simp [forceFalseAt, hib]
  | cons C σ ih =>
      have htail : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hb
        apply habs
        rw [← hSb]
        apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
        unfold receivedSet
        cases C <;> cases hr : roleOfIn i _ <;> simp_all
      cases C with
      | normal a c =>
          exact forceFalse_normal_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs
      | fstE a e c =>
          exact forceFalse_fstE_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs
      | sndE a c e =>
          exact forceFalse_sndE_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs

theorem normal_source_amalgamation{n} {S : @Dist n} {a b c : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n} (o : maxOne σ)
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (a_not_know_t : ¬ eval S ⟨σ, o⟩ (Form.K a (Form.Has b (b, true))))
    (ha : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, o⟩)
    (hc : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, o⟩) :
    ∃ (T : @Dist n) (τ : @OSequence n) (hτ : OSequence.length τ = σ.length),
      equiv a (S, ⟨⟨σ, o⟩, rfl⟩) (T, ⟨τ, hτ⟩) ∧
      T b = false ∧ resultSet c T τ = resultSet c S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
  classical
  let τ : @OSequence n := eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩
  have hτ : OSequence.length τ = σ.length := by
    simp [τ, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, OSequence.length]
  have heqa := forceFalse_eraseErrors_equi_of_true_absent (S := S) (b := b) (i := a)
    (σ := ⟨σ, o⟩) hSb ha
  have heqc := forceFalse_eraseErrors_equi_of_true_absent (S := S) (b := b) (i := c)
    (σ := ⟨σ, o⟩) hSb hc
  rcases heqa with ⟨hla, heqa⟩
  refine ⟨forceFalseAt b S, τ, hτ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [τ] using heqa
  · simp [forceFalseAt]
  · simpa [τ] using (indistinguishable_then_same_values heqc).symm

theorem eraseErrorAt_preserves_observation_shape{n} (b i : @Agent n) (C : @Call n) :
    (eraseErrorAt b C).pair = C.pair ∧
    roleOfIn i (eraseErrorAt b C) = roleOfIn i C := by
  cases C with
  | normal x y => simp [eraseErrorAt]
  | fstE x e y =>
      by_cases h : e = b <;> simp [eraseErrorAt, h, Call.pair, roleOfIn]
  | sndE x y e =>
      by_cases h : e = b <;> simp [eraseErrorAt, h, Call.pair, roleOfIn]

theorem eraseErrorsAt_preserves_sequence_constraints{n} (b : @Agent n) (σ : @Sequence n) :
    (eraseErrorsAt b σ).length = σ.length ∧
    (errFree σ → errFree (eraseErrorsAt b σ)) ∧
    (maxOne σ → maxOne (eraseErrorsAt b σ)) := by
  induction σ with
  | nil =>
      simp [eraseErrorsAt, errFree, maxOne]
  | cons c σ ih =>
      cases c with
      | normal x y =>
          simp [eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, errFree, maxOne] at ih ⊢
          exact ih
      | fstE x e y =>
          by_cases h : e = b
          · simp [eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, errFree, maxOne, h] at ih ⊢
            intro hfree
            exact ih.2 (Sequence.maxOne_of_errFree hfree)
          · simp [eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, errFree, maxOne, h] at ih ⊢
            exact ih.1
      | sndE x y e =>
          by_cases h : e = b
          · simp [eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, errFree, maxOne, h] at ih ⊢
            intro hfree
            exact ih.2 (Sequence.maxOne_of_errFree hfree)
          · simp [eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, errFree, maxOne, h] at ih ⊢
            exact ih.1

theorem collapseValueAt_image_eq_of_true_absent{n} {b : @Agent n} {A : Set (@Value n)}
    (h : (b, true) ∉ A) : collapseValueAt b '' A = A := by
  ext x
  rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨k, e⟩, hke, heq⟩
    by_cases hk : k = b
    · subst k
      cases e
      · have heq' : (b, false) = (j, d) := by
          simpa [collapseValueAt] using heq
        rwa [← heq']
      · exact (h hke).elim
    · have hfix : collapseValueAt b (k, e) = (k, e) := by
        simp [collapseValueAt, hk]
      rw [hfix] at heq
      rwa [← heq]
  · intro hjd
    refine ⟨(j, d), hjd, ?_⟩

def gossipRelComp {n : ℕ} (r s : GossipState n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i k => ∃ j, r i j ∧ s j k

def gossipTranspose {n : ℕ} (s : GossipState n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i j => s j i

def singleCallRel {n : ℕ} (c : Call n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i j => i = j ∨ (i = c.fst ∧ j = c.snd) ∨ (i = c.snd ∧ j = c.fst)

theorem makeCall_eq_relComp{n : ℕ} (s : GossipState n) (c : Call n) : makeCall s c = gossipRelComp (singleCallRel c) s := by
  funext i k

  by_cases hif : i = c.fst
  · simp [hif]
    aesop
  · by_cases his : i = c.snd
    · simp [his]
      aesop
    · simp [hif, his]

theorem gossipRelComp_assoc{n : ℕ} (r s t : GossipState n) : gossipRelComp (gossipRelComp r s) t = gossipRelComp r (gossipRelComp s t) := by
  funext i k

  unfold gossipRelComp
  aesop

theorem gossipTranspose_relComp{n : ℕ} (r s : GossipState n) : gossipTranspose (gossipRelComp r s) = gossipRelComp (gossipTranspose s) (gossipTranspose r) := by

  · rintro ⟨j, hr, hs⟩

  · rintro ⟨j, hs, hr⟩

  aesop

theorem after_append_relComp{n : ℕ} (S T : List (Call n)) : after (S ++ T) = gossipRelComp (after T) (after S) := by
  induction T using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      ext i k
      simp [after, makeCalls, gossipRelComp, initialState]
  | append_singleton T c ih =>
      rw [← List.append_assoc]
      change makeCalls (initialState n) ((S ++ T) ++ [c]) =
        gossipRelComp (makeCalls (initialState n) (T ++ [c]))
          (makeCalls (initialState n) S)
      change makeCalls (initialState n) (S ++ T) =
        gossipRelComp (makeCalls (initialState n) T)
          (makeCalls (initialState n) S) at ih
      rw [makeCalls_snoc, makeCalls_snoc]
      rw [makeCall_eq_relComp, makeCall_eq_relComp, ih]
      rw [gossipRelComp_assoc]

def callEndpoints {n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) : List (Fin n) :=
  L.flatMap (fun c => [c.fst, c.snd])

theorem callEndpoints_length{n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) : (callEndpoints L).length = 2 * L.length := by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c L ih =>
      simp [callEndpoints, ih]
      omega

theorem length_lower_bound_of_endpoints_cover{n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) (hcover : ∀ k : Fin n, k ∈ callEndpoints L) : n ≤ 2 * L.length := by
  have hfinset : (callEndpoints L).toFinset = Finset.univ := by
    ext k
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hcover k
  calc
    n = Fintype.card (Fin n) := by simp
    _ = (callEndpoints L).toFinset.card := by rw [hfinset]; simp
    _ ≤ (callEndpoints L).length := List.toFinset_card_le (callEndpoints L)
    _ = 2 * L.length := callEndpoints_length L

theorem initial_call_exists_of_occurs{n : ℕ} (S : List (Call n)) (k : Fin n)

          rcases hocc with ⟨c, hc, hck⟩
          simp at hc
          rcases hc with rfl | hc
          · exact False.elim (ha hck)
          · exact ⟨c, hc, hck⟩
        rcases ih htail with ⟨c, hc, hcS, hck⟩
        exact ⟨c, by simp [hc], by simpa [initial, ha] using hcS, hck⟩

theorem initial_filtered_endpoints_cover{n : ℕ} (S : List (Call n))
  (hocc : ∀ k : Fin n, ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k) :

    · exact ⟨habS, by simp [isInitialCall, isAgentInitialCall, hc]⟩

theorem noHo_call_endpoints_ne{m : ℕ} (T : List (Call m)) (hno : noHo T) (c : Call m) (hc : c ∈ T) : c.fst ≠ c.snd := by

theorem duplicate_final_endpoint_decomposition{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hdup : ¬(callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isFinalCall S c) S)).Nodup) :

    S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B ∧
    isFinalCall S c = true ∧ isFinalCall S d = true ∧

  let p : Call m → Bool := fun c => isFinalCall S c
  have mem_aux : ∀ (R : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m),
      x ∈ callEndpoints (R.filter p) →
      ∃ (A B : List (Call m)) (d : Call m),
        R = A ++ d :: B ∧ p d = true ∧ (x = d.fst ∨ x = d.snd) := by
    intro R x hx
    induction R with
    | nil => simp [callEndpoints] at hx
    | cons a R ih =>
      by_cases ha : p a = true

          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha, if_true, callEndpoints, List.flatMap_cons] using hx

        · exact ⟨[], R, a, rfl, ha, Or.inl hxa⟩
        · exact ⟨[], R, a, rfl, ha, Or.inr hxa⟩
        · obtain ⟨A, B, d, hR, hd, hxd⟩ := ih hxR

        obtain ⟨A, B, d, hR, hd, hxd⟩ := ih hx'
        exact ⟨a :: A, B, d, by simp [hR], hd, hxd⟩
  have aux : ∀ R : List (Call m),
      (∀ c ∈ R, c.fst ≠ c.snd) →
      ¬ (callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup →
      ∃ (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m),
        R = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B ∧
        p c = true ∧ p d = true ∧
        (c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) := by
    intro R hne hbad
    induction R with
    | nil => simp [callEndpoints] at hbad
    | cons a R ih =>
      have hne_a : a.fst ≠ a.snd := hne a (by simp)
      have hne_R : ∀ c ∈ R, c.fst ≠ c.snd := by
        intro c hc
        exact hne c (by simp [hc])
      by_cases ha : p a = true
      · have hbad' : ¬ (a.fst :: a.snd :: callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha, if_true, callEndpoints, List.flatMap_cons] using hbad
        by_cases hfst : a.fst ∈ a.snd :: callEndpoints (R.filter p)
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hfst with heq | hmem
          · exact False.elim (hne_a heq)
          · obtain ⟨Q, B, d, hR, hd, hshare⟩ := mem_aux R a.fst hmem
            exact ⟨[], Q, B, a, d, by simp [hR], ha, hd,
              hshare.elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (Or.inl h))⟩
        · by_cases hsnd : a.snd ∈ callEndpoints (R.filter p)
          · obtain ⟨Q, B, d, hR, hd, hshare⟩ := mem_aux R a.snd hsnd
            exact ⟨[], Q, B, a, d, by simp [hR], ha, hd,

            exact ⟨a :: A, Q, B, c, d, by simp [hR], hc, hd, hshare⟩

        have hbadR : ¬ (callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha', Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hbad
        obtain ⟨A, Q, B, c, d, hR, hc, hd, hshare⟩ := ih hne_R hbadR

theorem makeCall_idempotent{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (c : Call m) : makeCall (makeCall s c) c = makeCall s c := by
  funext i j
  by_cases hi₁ : i = c.fst <;> by_cases hi₂ : i = c.snd <;>
    simp [makeCall, hi₁, hi₂] <;> aesop

theorem noHo_repeated_call_gap_empty{m : ℕ} (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)
  (hno : noHo (A ++ c :: Q ++ c :: B)) : Q = [] := by
  cases Q with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q R =>
      exfalso
      have hi_bound : A.length + 1 + (q :: R).length < (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).length := by
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons]
        omega
      let i : Fin (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).length :=
        ⟨A.length + 1 + (q :: R).length, hi_bound⟩
      have hi := hno i
      have hi_val : i.val = (A ++ c :: q :: R).length := by
        simp [i]
        omega
      have hopt : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B)[i.val]? = some c := by
        rw [hi_val]
        simp
      have hget : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B)[i] = c := by
        apply Option.some.inj
        rw [← hopt]
        simp
      let P : List (Call m) := A ++ c :: (q :: R).take R.length
      have hP_len : P.length = i.val - 1 := by
        simp [P, i]
        omega
      have hdecomp : A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B =
          P ++ ((q :: R).drop R.length ++ c :: B) := by
        unfold P
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
        apply congrArg (fun xs => A ++ c :: xs)
        rw [← List.append_assoc, List.take_append_drop]
        rfl
      have htake : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).take (i.val - 1) = P := by
        rw [← hP_len]
        calc
          (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).take P.length =
              (P ++ ((q :: R).drop R.length ++ c :: B)).take P.length :=
            congrArg (List.take P.length) hdecomp
          _ = P := by simp
      rw [htake, hget] at hi
      rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
      have hbbA : after A b b :=
        (callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) A) b b rfl
      have hcall : makeCall (after A) (a, b) a b := by
        simp [makeCall, hbbA]
      have hpersist :
          makeCalls (makeCall (after A) (a, b)) ((q :: R).take R.length) a b :=
        (callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (after A) (a, b)) ((q :: R).take R.length)) a b hcall
      have hknow : after P a b := by
        simpa [P, after, makeCalls] using hpersist
      exact hi.1 hknow

theorem final_endpoint_tail_structure{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (k : Fin m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hck : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true) (hno : noHo S) :
  (∀ d ∈ T, d.fst ≠ k ∧ d.snd ≠ k) ∨
  ∃ B, T = c :: B ∧ ∀ d ∈ B, d.fst ≠ k ∧ d.snd ≠ k := by
  subst S
  unfold isAgentFinalCall at hfinal
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hfinal
  unfold final at hfinal
  let p : Call m → Bool := fun d => decide (d.fst = k ∨ d.snd = k)
  have hpc : p c = true := by
    simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact hck
  have hfind : List.find? p (T.reverse ++ c :: A.reverse) = some c := by
    simpa only [p, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil,
      List.nil_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using hfinal
  have find_later : ∀ U R : List (Call m),
      List.find? p (U ++ R) = some c →
      (∀ d ∈ U, p d = false) ∨
        ∃ P Q, U = P ++ c :: Q ∧ ∀ d ∈ P, p d = false := by
    intro U
    induction U with
    | nil =>
        intro R h
        left
        simp
    | cons d U ih =>
        intro R h
        by_cases hd : p d = true
        · right
          have hdc : d = c := by
            apply Option.some.inj
            simpa only [List.cons_append, List.find?_cons, hd, Bool.true_eq] using h
          subst d
          exact ⟨[], U, by simp, by simp⟩
        · have hd0 : p d = false := by
            cases hpd : p d <;> simp_all
          have htail : List.find? p (U ++ R) = some c := by
            simpa only [List.cons_append, List.find?_cons, hd0, Bool.false_eq] using h
          rcases ih R htail with hall | ⟨P, Q, hU, hP⟩
          · left
            intro x hx
            simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
            rcases hx with rfl | hx
            · exact hd0
            · exact hall x hx
          · right
            exact ⟨d :: P, Q, by simp only [List.cons_append, hU], by
              intro x hx
              simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
              rcases hx with rfl | hx
              · exact hd0
              · exact hP x hx⟩
  rcases find_later T.reverse (c :: A.reverse) hfind with hall | ⟨P, Q, hrev, hP⟩
  · left
    intro d hd
    have hdrev : d ∈ T.reverse := by simpa using hd
    have hp0 := hall d hdrev
    simp only [p, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hp0
    push_neg at hp0
    exact hp0
  · have hT : T = Q.reverse ++ c :: P.reverse := by
      rw [← List.reverse_reverse T, hrev]
      simp only [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_reverse,
        List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    have hgap : Q.reverse = [] := by
      apply noHo_repeated_call_gap_empty A Q.reverse P.reverse c
      rw [hT] at hno
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using hno
    have hQ : Q = [] := by simpa using hgap
    subst Q
    right
    refine ⟨P.reverse, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hT, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append]
    · intro d hd
      have hdP : d ∈ P := by simpa using hd
      have hp0 := hP d hdP
      simp only [p, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hp0
      push_neg at hp0
      exact hp0

theorem final_endpoint_expert_after_call{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (k : Fin m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hck : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true)
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) (hno : noHo S) :
  isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) k := by
  rcases final_endpoint_tail_structure S A T c k hS hck hfinal hno with hT | ⟨B, hTB, hB⟩
  · intro j
    have hfull : after S k j := hExp k j
    rw [hS] at hfull
    have htail : makeCalls (after (A ++ [c])) T k j := by
      simpa only [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil] using hfull
    exact (makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (after (A ++ [c])) T k j hT).mp htail
  · intro j
    have hfull : after S k j := hExp k j
    rw [hS, hTB] at hfull
    have htail : makeCalls (after (A ++ [c])) B k j := by
      simpa only [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil, makeCall_idempotent] using hfull
    exact (makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (after (A ++ [c])) B k j hB).mp htail

theorem makeCall_participant_expertise_iff{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (c : Call m) :
  isExpert (makeCall s c) c.fst ↔ isExpert (makeCall s c) c.snd := by
  by_cases h : c.snd = c.fst <;> simp [isExpert, makeCall, h, or_comm]

theorem final_selected_call_makes_both_expert{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hc : isFinalCall S c = true)
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) (hno : noHo S) :
  isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst ∧ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd := by
  unfold isFinalCall at hc
  have hc' : isAgentFinalCall S c.fst c = true ∨ isAgentFinalCall S c.snd c = true :=
    of_decide_eq_true hc
  rcases hc' with hfst | hsnd
  · have he1 : isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst :=
      final_endpoint_expert_after_call S A T c c.fst hS (Or.inl rfl) hfst hExp hno
    constructor
    · exact he1
    · unfold after at he1 ⊢
      rw [makeCalls_snoc] at he1 ⊢
      exact (makeCall_participant_expertise_iff (makeCalls (initialState m) A) c).mp he1
  · have he2 : isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd :=
      final_endpoint_expert_after_call S A T c c.snd hS (Or.inr rfl) hsnd hExp hno
    constructor
    · unfold after at he2 ⊢
      rw [makeCalls_snoc] at he2 ⊢
      exact (makeCall_participant_expertise_iff (makeCalls (initialState m) A) c).mpr he2
    · exact he2

theorem noHo_nonadjacent_later_call_has_no_expert_endpoint{m : ℕ} (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hQ : Q ≠ []) (hno : noHo (A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)) :
  ¬ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) d.fst ∧ ¬ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) d.snd := by
  rcases Q with _ | ⟨q, R⟩
  · exact (hQ rfl).elim
  · have htake :
        List.take (A.length + 1 + R.length) (A ++ c :: q :: (R ++ d :: B)) =
          (A ++ [c]) ++ (q :: R).take R.length := by
      rw [List.take_append]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega)]
      have hsub : A.length + 1 + R.length - A.length = R.length + 1 := by omega
      rw [hsub]
      simp only [List.take_succ_cons]
      have ht : List.take R.length (q :: (R ++ d :: B)) = List.take R.length (q :: R) := by
        change List.take R.length ((q :: R) ++ d :: B) = List.take R.length (q :: R)
        exact List.take_append_of_le_length (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ht]
    have hget :
        (A ++ c :: q :: (R ++ d :: B))[A.length + 1 + (R.length + 1)] = d := by
      have hget' := List.getElem_append_right' (A ++ c :: q :: R) (l₂ := d :: B) (i := 0) (by simp)
      convert hget'.symm using 1
      · simp only [List.append_assoc, List.length_append, List.length_cons, zero_add]
        congr 1
        omega
    have hd := hno ⟨A.length + 1 + (q :: R).length, by simp; omega⟩
    simp [noHo] at hd
    rw [hget, htake] at hd
    constructor
    · intro hexp
      apply hd.1
      have hmore := callsIncreaseGossip (after (A ++ [c])) ((q :: R).take R.length)
      have hknow := hexp d.2
      have hpersist := hmore d.1 d.2 hknow
      simpa [after, makeCalls] using hpersist
    · intro hexp
      apply hd.2
      have hmore := callsIncreaseGossip (after (A ++ [c])) ((q :: R).take R.length)
      have hknow := hexp d.1
      have hpersist := hmore d.2 d.1 hknow
      simpa [after, makeCalls] using hpersist

theorem separated_final_chain_impossible{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) : Q = [] := by
  cases Q with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons q R =>
      exfalso
      have hnot :=
        noHo_nonadjacent_later_call_has_no_expert_endpoint A (q :: R) B c d
          (by simp) (by simpa [hS] using noHo_S)
      have hexp :=
        final_selected_call_makes_both_expert S A ((q :: R) ++ d :: B) c
          (by simpa using hS) hc S_allExp noHo_S
      rcases hshare with h | h | h | h
      · exact hnot.1 (h ▸ hexp.1)
      · exact hnot.2 (h ▸ hexp.1)
      · exact hnot.1 (h ▸ hexp.2)
      · exact hnot.2 (h ▸ hexp.2)

theorem repeated_final_endpoint_yields_adjacent_chain{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hdup : ¬(callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isFinalCall S c) S)).Nodup) :
  ∃ (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m),
    S = A ++ c :: d :: B ∧
    isFinalCall S c = true ∧ isFinalCall S d = true ∧
    (c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) := by
  rcases duplicate_final_endpoint_decomposition S noHo_S hdup with ⟨A, Q, B, c, d, hS, hc, hd, hshare⟩
  have hQ : Q = [] :=
    separated_final_chain_impossible S S_allExp noHo_S A Q B c d hS hc hd hshare
  subst Q
  exact ⟨A, B, c, d, by simpa only [List.append_nil, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hS, hc, hd, hshare⟩

def stateMappedBy {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, s a b → t (μ a) (μ b)

def quotientCall {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (c : Call m) : Option (Call r) :=
  if μ c.fst = μ c.snd then none else some (μ c.fst, μ c.snd)

def quotientCalls {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (S : List (Call m)) : List (Call r) :=
  S.filterMap (quotientCall μ)

theorem initialState_stateMappedBy{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) : stateMappedBy μ (initialState m) (initialState r) := by
  intro a b hab
  change a = b at hab
  change μ a = μ b
  exact congrArg μ hab

theorem makeCall_quotient_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (c : Call m)
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  stateMappedBy μ (makeCall s c)
    (if μ c.fst = μ c.snd then t else makeCall t (μ c.fst, μ c.snd)) := by
  unfold stateMappedBy at *
  intro a b hab
  split_ifs with hc
  · simp [makeCall] at * <;> grind
  · simp [makeCall] at * <;> grind

theorem makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (S : List (Call m))
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  stateMappedBy μ (makeCalls s S) (makeCalls t (quotientCalls μ S)) := by
  induction S generalizing s t with
  | nil =>
      simpa [quotientCalls] using hmap
  | cons c S ih =>
      simp only [quotientCalls, List.filterMap_cons, quotientCall]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp only [makeCalls_cons]
        apply ih
        simpa only [h, if_pos] using makeCall_quotient_simulates μ s t c hmap
      · simp only [makeCalls_cons]
        apply ih
        simpa only [h, if_neg] using makeCall_quotient_simulates μ s t c hmap

theorem allExpert_after_quotientCalls{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (hμ : Function.Surjective μ) (S : List (Call m))
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) : allExpert (after (quotientCalls μ S)) := by
  have hmap := makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates μ (initialState m) (initialState r) S
    (initialState_stateMappedBy μ)
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hμ a
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hμ b
  rw [← ha', ← hb']
  exact hmap a' b' (hExp a' b')

theorem quotientCalls_length_le_of_two_collapses{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (S A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)
  (hc : quotientCall μ c = none) (hd : quotientCall μ d = none) :
  (quotientCalls μ S).length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  subst S
  unfold quotientCalls
  have hlen : ∀ L : List (Call m), (L.filterMap (quotientCall μ)).length ≤ L.length := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.filterMap_cons]
      split <;> simp_all <;> omega
  simp only [List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, hc, hd,
    List.length_append, List.length_cons]
  have hA := hlen A
  have hQ := hlen Q
  have hB := hlen B
  omega

theorem exists_surjective_pair_merge{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (a b : Fin m) (hab : a ≠ b) :
  ∃ μ : Fin m → Fin (m - 1), Function.Surjective μ ∧ μ a = μ b := by
  have hcard : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  let e : Fin m ≃ Fin (m - 1 + 1) := Fin.castOrderIso hcard.symm
  let a' : Fin (m - 1 + 1) := e a
  let b' : Fin (m - 1 + 1) := e b
  have hab' : a' ≠ b' := by
    intro h
    apply hab
    exact e.injective h
  let q : Fin (m - 1) := (finSuccAboveEquiv b').symm ⟨a', hab'⟩
  let μ : Fin m → Fin (m - 1) := fun x =>
    if hx : e x = b' then q else (finSuccAboveEquiv b').symm ⟨e x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨μ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    refine ⟨e.symm (b'.succAbove y), ?_⟩
    simp only [μ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [dif_neg (b'.succAbove_ne y)]
    apply (finSuccAboveEquiv b').injective
    simp [finSuccAboveEquiv_apply]
  · simp [μ, q, a', b', hab']

theorem shorter_counterexample_of_adjacent_repeated_call{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S))
  (noHo_S : noHo S) (A B : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: c :: B) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  have hcS : c ∈ S := by
    rw [hS]
    simp
  have hc_ne : c.fst ≠ c.snd :=
    noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S c hcS
  obtain ⟨μ, hμsurj, hμeq⟩ :=
    exists_surjective_pair_merge hm c.fst c.snd hc_ne
  refine ⟨quotientCalls μ S, allExpert_after_quotientCalls μ hμsurj S S_allExp, ?_⟩
  have hc_none : quotientCall μ c = none := by
    simp [quotientCall, hμeq]
  exact quotientCalls_length_le_of_two_collapses μ S A [] B c c
    (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hS) hc_none hc_none

theorem isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (L : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m)
  (hx : isExpert s x) : isExpert (makeCalls s L) x := by
  intro j
  exact callsIncreaseGossip s L x j (hx j)

theorem exists_terminal_expert_call{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (P₀ T₀ : List (Call m)) (c₀ : Call m) (x₀ : Fin m)
  (hS₀ : S = P₀ ++ c₀ :: T₀)
  (hx₀c : c₀.fst = x₀ ∨ c₀.snd = x₀)
  (hx₀ : isExpert (after P₀) x₀) :
  ∃ (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x y : Fin m),
    S = P ++ c :: T ∧
    ((c.fst = x ∧ c.snd = y) ∨ (c.fst = y ∧ c.snd = x)) ∧
    x ≠ y ∧ isExpert (after P) x ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, e.fst ≠ y ∧ e.snd ≠ y := by
  classical
  have expertMakesExpert_rev {s : GossipState m} {i j : Fin m}
      (h : isExpert s j) : isExpert (makeCall s (i, j)) i := by
    unfold isExpert at *
    intro z
    simp [makeCall, h z]
  have split_mem : ∀ {a : Call m} {l : List (Call m)}, a ∈ l →
      ∃ u v, l = u ++ a :: v := by
    intro a l h
    induction l with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l ih =>
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
        rcases h with rfl | h
        · exact ⟨[], l, rfl⟩
        · rcases ih h with ⟨u, v, huv⟩
          exact ⟨b :: u, v, by simp [huv]⟩
  have aux : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x : Fin m),
      T.length = k → S = P ++ c :: T →
      (c.fst = x ∨ c.snd = x) → isExpert (after P) x →
      ∃ (P' T' : List (Call m)) (c' : Call m) (x' y' : Fin m),
        S = P' ++ c' :: T' ∧
        ((c'.fst = x' ∧ c'.snd = y') ∨ (c'.fst = y' ∧ c'.snd = x')) ∧
        x' ≠ y' ∧ isExpert (after P') x' ∧
        ∀ e ∈ T', e.fst ≠ y' ∧ e.snd ≠ y' := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
        intro P T c x hlen hdecomp hcx hx
        rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
        simp only at hcx
        rcases hcx with hax | hbx
        · subst x
          have hcS : (a, b) ∈ S := by
            rw [hdecomp]
            simp
          have hab : a ≠ b := noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S (a, b) hcS
          by_cases hocc : ∃ d ∈ T, d.fst = b ∨ d.snd = b
          · rcases hocc with ⟨d, hdT, hdend⟩
            rcases split_mem hdT with ⟨A, B, hsplit⟩
            have hb_call : isExpert (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) b :=
              expertMakesExpert hx
            have hbpre : isExpert (after (P ++ (a, b) :: A)) b := by
              have hp := isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls
                (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) A b hb_call
              simpa [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hp
            have hlt : B.length < k := by
              rw [← hlen, hsplit]
              simp
              omega
            have hdecomp' : S = (P ++ (a, b) :: A) ++ d :: B := by
              rw [hdecomp, hsplit]
              simp
            exact ih B.length hlt (P ++ (a, b) :: A) B d b rfl hdecomp' hdend hbpre
          · exact ⟨P, T, (a, b), a, b, hdecomp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hab, hx, by
              intro e he
              constructor
              · intro heb
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inl heb⟩
              · intro heb
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inr heb⟩⟩
        · subst x
          have hcS : (a, b) ∈ S := by
            rw [hdecomp]
            simp
          have hab : a ≠ b := noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S (a, b) hcS
          have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
          by_cases hocc : ∃ d ∈ T, d.fst = a ∨ d.snd = a
          · rcases hocc with ⟨d, hdT, hdend⟩
            rcases split_mem hdT with ⟨A, B, hsplit⟩
            have ha_call : isExpert (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) a :=
              expertMakesExpert_rev hx
            have hapre : isExpert (after (P ++ (a, b) :: A)) a := by
              have hp := isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls
                (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) A a ha_call
              simpa [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hp
            have hlt : B.length < k := by
              rw [← hlen, hsplit]
              simp
              omega
            have hdecomp' : S = (P ++ (a, b) :: A) ++ d :: B := by
              rw [hdecomp, hsplit]
              simp
            exact ih B.length hlt (P ++ (a, b) :: A) B d a rfl hdecomp' hdend hapre
          · exact ⟨P, T, (a, b), b, a, hdecomp, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hba, hx, by
              intro e he
              constructor
              · intro hea
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inl hea⟩
              · intro hea
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inr hea⟩⟩
  exact aux T₀.length P₀ T₀ c₀ x₀ rfl hS₀ hx₀c hx₀

theorem initial_endpoints_nodup_of_exact_count{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (T : List (Call m)) (T_allExp : allExpert (after T))
  (hcount : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T).length) :
  (callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T)).Nodup := by
  let I : List (Call m) := List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T
  let E : List (Fin m) := callEndpoints I
  have hcover : ∀ k : Fin m, k ∈ E := by
    intro k
    exact initial_filtered_endpoints_cover T
      (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp) k
  have hfin : E.toFinset = Finset.univ := by
    ext k
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hcover k
  have hcard : E.toFinset.card = m := by
    rw [hfin]
    simpa using (Fintype.card_fin m)
  have hlen : E.length = 2 * (m / 2) := by
    calc
      E.length = 2 * I.length := callEndpoints_length I
      _ = 2 * (m / 2) := by rw [hcount]
  have hcard_le : E.toFinset.card ≤ E.length := List.toFinset_card_le E
  have hlen_le : E.length ≤ m := by omega
  have heq : E.toFinset.card = E.length := by omega
  simpa using
    (Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mp (show (E : Multiset (Fin m)).toFinset.card = (E : Multiset (Fin m)).card by simpa using heq))

theorem initial_matching_edge_for_agent{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (T : List (Call m)) (T_allExp : allExpert (after T))
  (hcount : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T).length)
  (k : Fin m) :
  ∃ (p : Fin m) (c : Call m), p ≠ k ∧ c ∈ T ∧
    ((c.fst = k ∧ c.snd = p) ∨ (c.fst = p ∧ c.snd = k)) ∧
    isAgentInitialCall T k c = true ∧ isAgentInitialCall T p c = true := by
  obtain ⟨c, hcT, hcinit, hck⟩ :=
    initial_call_exists_of_occurs T k (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp k)
  have hnodup := initial_endpoints_nodup_of_exact_count hm T T_allExp hcount
  rw [callEndpoints, List.nodup_flatMap] at hnodup
  rcases hck with hfst | hsnd
  · let p := c.snd
    have hcInitK : isAgentInitialCall T k c = true := by
      simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hcinit
    have hcInitial : isInitialCall T c = true := by
      simp [isInitialCall, hfst, hcInitK]
    have hcF : c ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
      simp [hcT, hcInitial]
    have hcEnds := hnodup.1 c hcF
    refine ⟨p, c, ?_, hcT, Or.inl ⟨hfst, rfl⟩, hcInitK, ?_⟩

theorem expert_agent_occurs_in_prefix{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (P : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m)
  (hx : isExpert (after P) x) :
  ∃ c ∈ P, c.fst = x ∨ c.snd = x := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hnon : ∀ c ∈ P, c.fst ≠ x ∧ c.snd ≠ x := by
    intro c hc
    have hc' := h c hc
    constructor <;> tauto
  have hrow : ∀ j : Fin m, after P x j ↔ initialState m x j := by
    intro j
    exact makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (initialState m) P x j hnon
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card (Fin m) := by simpa using hm
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hcard x
  have hxj : after P x j := hx j
  have hini : initialState m x j := (hrow j).mp hxj
  exact hj (by simpa [initialState] using hini.symm)

theorem initial_value_mem_prefix_of_occurrence{m : ℕ} (S P T : List (Call m)) (c e : Call m) (x : Fin m)
  (hS : S = P ++ c :: T)
  (hinit : initial S x = some e)
  (hocc : ∃ q ∈ P, q.fst = x ∨ q.snd = x) : e ∈ P := by
  subst S
  induction P with
  | nil => simp at hocc
  | cons a P ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append] at hinit
    by_cases ha1 : a.fst = x
    · simp [initial, ha1] at hinit
      subst e
      simp
    · by_cases ha2 : a.snd = x
      · simp [initial, ha1, ha2] at hinit
        subst e
        simp
      · simp only [initial, List.find?_cons, ha1, ha2, Bool.false_or] at hinit
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hocc ⊢
        rcases hocc with ⟨q, hq, hendpoint⟩
        rcases hq with rfl | hq
        · exact (hendpoint.elim ha1 ha2).elim
        · right
          apply ih
          · exact ⟨q, hq, hendpoint⟩
          · exact hinit

theorem makeCall_comm{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (a b : Fin m) : makeCall s (a, b) = makeCall s (b, a) := by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    rfl
  · funext i j
    unfold makeCall
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · subst i
      simp only [if_pos, if_neg, if_false, hab, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true]
    · by_cases hib : i = b
      · subst i
        have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
        simp only [if_pos, if_neg, if_false, hab, hba, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true]
      · have hai : a ≠ i := fun h => hia h.symm
        have hbi : b ≠ i := fun h => hib h.symm
        simp only [if_neg, if_false, hia, hib, hai, hbi]

theorem skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r)
  (x y : Fin m) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : isExpert s x)
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (x, y)) t := by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  unfold makeCall at hab
  by_cases hax : a = x
  · subst a
    exact hmap x b (hx b)
  · by_cases hay : a = y
    · exact (ha hay).elim
    · apply hmap a b
      simpa only [hax, hay, ↓reduceIte] using hab

theorem makeCalls_survivor_simulates_of_avoids{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (y : Fin m)
  (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (L : List (Call m))
  (havoid : ∀ c ∈ L, c.fst ≠ y ∧ c.snd ≠ y)
  (hmap : survivorMappedBy μ y s t) :
  survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCalls s L) (makeCalls t (quotientCalls μ L)) := by
  induction L generalizing s t with
  | nil =>
      simpa [quotientCalls, makeCalls] using hmap
  | cons c L ih =>
      rcases c with ⟨i, j⟩
      have hij : i ≠ y ∧ j ≠ y := havoid (i, j) (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ c ∈ L, c.fst ≠ y ∧ c.snd ≠ y := by
        intro c hc
        exact havoid c (by simp [hc])
      by_cases heq : μ i = μ j
      · have hstep : survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (i, j)) t := by
          unfold survivorMappedBy at hmap ⊢
          intro a ha b hb hab
          by_cases hai : a = i
          · subst a
            simp [makeCall] at hab
            rcases hab with hi | hj
            · exact hmap i hij.1 b hb hi
            · rw [heq]
              exact hmap j hij.2 b hb hj
          · by_cases haj : a = j
            · subst a
              simp [makeCall, hai] at hab
              rcases hab with hj | hi
              · exact hmap j hij.2 b hb hj
              · rw [← heq]
                exact hmap i hij.1 b hb hi
            · simp [makeCall, hai, haj] at hab
              exact hmap a ha b hb hab
        simpa [makeCalls_cons, quotientCalls, quotientCall, heq] using
          ih (makeCall s (i, j)) t htail hstep
      · have hstep : survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (i, j))
            (makeCall t (μ i, μ j)) := by
          unfold survivorMappedBy at hmap ⊢
          intro a ha b hb hab
          by_cases hai : a = i
          · subst a
            simp [makeCall] at hab ⊢
            rcases hab with hi | hj
            · exact Or.inl (hmap i hij.1 b hb hi)
            · exact Or.inr (hmap j hij.2 b hb hj)
          · by_cases haj : a = j
            · subst a
              have hji : μ j ≠ μ i := fun h => heq h.symm
              simp [makeCall, hai, hji] at hab ⊢
              rcases hab with hj | hi
              · exact Or.inl (hmap j hij.2 b hb hj)
              · exact Or.inr (hmap i hij.1 b hb hi)
            · simp [makeCall, hai, haj] at hab
              have ht : t (μ a) (μ b) := hmap a ha b hb hab
              simp [makeCall, ht]
        simpa [makeCalls_cons, quotientCalls, quotientCall, heq] using
          ih (makeCall s (i, j)) (makeCall t (μ i, μ j)) htail hstep

theorem allExpert_of_survivorMappedBy{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (hμ : Function.Surjective μ)
  (y p : Fin m) (hyp : p ≠ y) (hpy : μ p = μ y)
  (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r)
  (hExp : allExpert s) (hmap : survivorMappedBy μ y s t) : allExpert t := by
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hμ i
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hμ j
  by_cases ha : a = y
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b = y
    · subst b
      simpa only [hpy] using hmap p hyp p hyp (hExp p p)
    · simpa only [hpy] using hmap p hyp b hb (hExp p b)
  · by_cases hb : b = y
    · subst b
      simpa only [hpy] using hmap a ha p hyp (hExp a p)
    · exact hmap a ha b hb (hExp a b)

theorem quotientCalls_length_le_of_one_collapse{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (P P₁ P₂ : List (Call m)) (e : Call m)
  (hP : P = P₁ ++ e :: P₂) (he : quotientCall μ e = none) :
  (quotientCalls μ P).length ≤ P.length - 1 := by
  subst P
  have hfilter : ∀ L : List (Call m), (L.filterMap (quotientCall μ)).length ≤ L.length := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a L ih =>
      cases h : quotientCall μ a <;> simp [List.filterMap_cons, h] <;> omega
  have h₁ := hfilter P₁
  have h₂ := hfilter P₂
  simp [quotientCalls, he, List.filterMap_append] at *
  omega

theorem terminal_expert_call_contraction{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S))
  (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x y p : Fin m)
  (hS : S = P ++ c :: T)
  (hc : (c.fst = x ∧ c.snd = y) ∨ (c.fst = y ∧ c.snd = x))
  (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : isExpert (after P) x)
  (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.fst ≠ y ∧ e.snd ≠ y)
  (P₁ P₂ : List (Call m)) (e₀ : Call m)
  (hP : P = P₁ ++ e₀ :: P₂)
  (he₀ : (e₀.fst = y ∧ e₀.snd = p) ∨ (e₀.fst = p ∧ e₀.snd = y))
  (hpy : p ≠ y) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμpy⟩ := exists_surjective_pair_merge hm p y hpy
  refine ⟨quotientCalls μ P ++ quotientCalls μ T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmapP : stateMappedBy μ (after P) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) := by
      simpa [after] using
        (makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates μ (initialState m) (initialState (m - 1)) P
          (initialState_stateMappedBy μ))
    have hsurvC :
        survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall (after P) c) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) := by
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · have hceq : c = (x, y) := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact hc.1
          · exact hc.2
        rw [hceq]
        exact skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates μ (after P)
          (after (quotientCalls μ P)) x y hxy hx hmapP
      · have hceq : c = (y, x) := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact hc.1
          · exact hc.2
        rw [hceq, makeCall_comm]
        exact skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates μ (after P)
          (after (quotientCalls μ P)) x y hxy hx hmapP
    have hsurvT := makeCalls_survivor_simulates_of_avoids μ y
      (makeCall (after P) c) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) T hT hsurvC
    apply allExpert_of_survivorMappedBy μ hμ y p hpy hμpy (after S)
      (after (quotientCalls μ P ++ quotientCalls μ T)) S_allExp
    simpa [after, hS, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hsurvT
  · have heq : μ e₀.fst = μ e₀.snd := by
      rcases he₀ with he₀ | he₀
      · rw [he₀.1, he₀.2]
        exact hμpy.symm
      · rw [he₀.1, he₀.2]
        exact hμpy
    have he₀none : quotientCall μ e₀ = none := by
      simp [quotientCall, heq]
    have hlenP := quotientCalls_length_le_of_one_collapse μ P P₁ P₂ e₀ hP he₀none
    have hlenT : (quotientCalls μ T).length ≤ T.length := by
      exact List.length_filterMap_le (quotientCall μ) T
    have hPpos : 0 < P.length := by
      rw [hP]
      simp
    simp only [List.length_append]
    rw [hS]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    omega

theorem shorter_counterexample_of_distinct_adjacent_final_chain{m : ℕ} (le_m : 4 < m) (S : List (Call m))
  (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hinit : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall S c) S).length)
  (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd)
  (hcd : c ≠ d) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  have hm : 1 < m := by omega
  have hS_d : S = (A ++ [c]) ++ d :: B := by
    rw [hS]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  have hcExp :
      isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst ∧
        isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd := by
    exact final_selected_call_makes_both_expert S A (d :: B) c hS hc S_allExp noHo_S
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀c, hx₀⟩ :
      ∃ x₀ : Fin m, (d.fst = x₀ ∨ d.snd = x₀) ∧
        isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) x₀ := by
    rcases hshare with h | h | h | h
    · exact ⟨d.fst, Or.inl rfl, h ▸ hcExp.1⟩
    · exact ⟨d.snd, Or.inr rfl, h ▸ hcExp.1⟩
    · exact ⟨d.fst, Or.inl rfl, h ▸ hcExp.2⟩
    · exact ⟨d.snd, Or.inr rfl, h ▸ hcExp.2⟩
  obtain ⟨P, T, e, x, y, hSP, he, hxy, hx, hT⟩ :=
    exists_terminal_expert_call S noHo_S (A ++ [c]) B d x₀ hS_d hx₀c hx₀
  obtain ⟨p, e₀, hpy, he₀S, he₀, he₀y, he₀p⟩ :=
    initial_matching_edge_for_agent hm S S_allExp hinit y
  have he₀P : e₀ ∈ P := by
    rw [hSP] at he₀S
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at he₀S
    rcases he₀S with he₀P | rfl | he₀T
    · exact he₀P
    · have hpx : p = x := by grind
      have hinitx : initial S x = some e₀ := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall, hpx] using he₀p
      obtain ⟨q, hqP, hqx⟩ := expert_agent_occurs_in_prefix hm P x hx
      exact initial_value_mem_prefix_of_occurrence S P T e₀ e₀ x hSP hinitx ⟨q, hqP, hqx⟩
    · have hne := hT e₀ he₀T
      grind
  obtain ⟨P₁, P₂, hP⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp he₀P
  exact terminal_expert_call_contraction hm S S_allExp P T e x y p
    hSP he hxy hx hT P₁ P₂ e₀ hP he₀ hpy

theorem adjacent_final_chain_contradicts_minimality(m : ℕ)
  (m_is_minimal : ∀ n < m, ¬∃ (_ : 4 < n) (x : List (Call n)) (_ : allExpert (after x)), x.length < 2 * n - 4)
  (le_m : 4 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (S_len_lt : S.length ≤ 2 * m - 5)
  (hinit : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall S c) S).length)
  (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) : False := by

    rcases shorter_counterexample_of_adjacent_repeated_call (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp noHo_S A B c hS with ⟨U, hUexp, hUlen⟩
    have hlower := initial_filter_length_lower_bound (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp

    exact ⟨by omega, U, hUexp, by omega⟩
  · rcases shorter_counterexample_of_distinct_adjacent_final_chain le_m S S_allExp noHo_S hinit A B c d hS hc hd hshare hcd with ⟨U, hUexp, hUlen⟩
    have hlower := initial_filter_length_lower_bound (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp
    have heven : m % 2 = 0 := by

    apply m_is_minimal (m - 1) (by omega)
    exact ⟨by omega, U, hUexp, by omega⟩

theorem minimal_counterexample_final_endpoints_nodup(m : ℕ)
  (m_is_minimal : ∀ n < m, ¬∃ (_ : 4 < n) (x : List (Call n)) (_ : allExpert (after x)), x.length < 2 * n - 4)
