theorem filter_reverse_eq{α : Type*} (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) : (xs.filter p).reverse = xs.reverse.filter p := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a xs ih =>
      simp only [List.filter_cons]
      split <;> simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.filter_append, ih, List.filter_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil, List.nil_append] <;> simp_all

  (List.filter (fun c : Call n => isFinalCall S c) S).reverse =

  congr 1

theorem callEndpoints_reverse_perm{n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) : (callEndpoints L.reverse).Perm (callEndpoints L) := by
  have move_pair : ∀ (xs : List (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n),
      (xs ++ [a, b]).Perm (a :: b :: xs) := by
    intro xs a b
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        simp
    | cons x xs ih =>
        exact (ih.cons x).trans
          ((List.Perm.swap a x (b :: xs)).trans
            ((List.Perm.swap b x xs).cons a))
  induction L with
  | nil =>
      simp [callEndpoints]
  | cons c L ih =>
      simp only [List.reverse_cons, callEndpoints, List.flatMap_append,
        List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil]
      exact (ih.append_right [c.fst, c.snd]).trans
        (move_pair (callEndpoints L) c.fst c.snd)

theorem sorrydb_60fb8d91fd5975a6(hyp : ∃ (x : ℕ) (_ : 4 < x) (x_1 : List (Call x)) (_ : allExpert (after x_1)), x_1.length < 2 * x - 4)

      _ = ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * C := by rw [hxy]; simp
  · have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx
      simp [hx] at hxy
    letI : Nontrivial H := ⟨⟨x, 0, hx0⟩⟩
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := spectrum.nonempty a
      exact le_trans (norm_nonneg (f ⟨z, hz⟩)) (hf_bounded ⟨z, hz⟩)
    calc
      ‖μ.integral f‖ ≤ max C 0 * μ.var.real Set.univ := hint
      _ = C * μ.var.real Set.univ := by rw [max_eq_left hC]
      _ ≤ C * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass hC
      _ = ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * C := by ring

theorem spectralProjectionAux_add_disjoint{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {w₁ w₂ : Set (spectrum ℂ a)} (hw₁ : MeasurableSet w₁)
    (hw₂ : MeasurableSet w₂) (hdis : Disjoint w₁ w₂) :
    spectralProjectionAux ha (w₁ ∪ w₂) =
      spectralProjectionAux ha w₁ + spectralProjectionAux ha w₂ := by
  ext x
  apply ext_inner_right ℂ
  intro y
  simp only [spectralProjectionAux, InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, inner_add_left]
  change (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral ((w₁ ∪ w₂).indicator 1) =
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral (w₁.indicator 1) +
      (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral (w₂.indicator 1)
  have hind : (w₁ ∪ w₂).indicator (1 : spectrum ℂ a → ℂ) =
      w₁.indicator 1 + w₂.indicator 1 := by
    funext z
    by_cases h₁ : z ∈ w₁
    · have h₂ : z ∉ w₂ := by
        intro hz
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis h₁ hz
      simp [h₁, h₂]
    · by_cases h₂ : z ∈ w₂
      · simp [h₁, h₂]
      · simp [h₁, h₂]
  have hint (w : Set (spectrum ℂ a)) (hw : MeasurableSet w) :
      Integrable (fun z => (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).ang z •
        w.indicator (1 : spectrum ℂ a → ℂ) z) (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).var := by
    have h := (MeasureTheory.ComplexMeasure.integrable_rnDeriv
      (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y) (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).var).indicator hw
    rw [show (fun z => (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).ang z •
        w.indicator (1 : spectrum ℂ a → ℂ) z) =
        w.indicator (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).ang by
      funext z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ w <;> simp [hz]]
    simpa [ComplexMeasure.ang] using h
  rw [hind]
  unfold ComplexMeasure.integral
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, smul_add]
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_add (hint w₁ hw₁) (hint w₂ hw₂)

theorem idempotent_sum_mul_eq_zero{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (p q : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hp : p * p = p) (hq : q * q = q)
    (hpq : (p + q) * (p + q) = p + q) :
    p * q = 0 ∧ q * p = 0 := by
  have hsum : p * q + q * p = 0 := by
    calc
      p * q + q * p = p * p + p * q + q * p + q * q - (p + q) := by
        rw [hp, hq]
        abel
      _ = (p + q) * (p + q) - (p + q) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hpq
  have hleft := congrArg (fun x : H →L[ℂ] H => p * x) hsum
  have hright := congrArg (fun x : H →L[ℂ] H => x * p) hsum
  simp only [mul_add, mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, hp] at hleft
  simp only [add_mul, zero_mul, mul_assoc, hp] at hright
  rw [mul_assoc] at hleft
  have hpq_eq_qp : p * q = q * p := by
    calc
      p * q = p * q + (p * (q * p) + q * p) := by rw [hright, add_zero]
      _ = (p * q + p * (q * p)) + q * p := by abel
      _ = q * p := by rw [hleft, zero_add]
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) • (p * q) = 0 := by
    simpa only [two_smul, hpq_eq_qp] using hsum
  have hpq_zero : p * q = 0 := by
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  exact ⟨hpq_zero, hpq_eq_qp ▸ hpq_zero⟩

theorem cfc_toComplexMeasure_integral_continuous{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    (x y : H) (f : C((spectrum ℂ a), ℂ)) :
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral f =
      ⟪x, (cfcHom ha.isStarNormal f) y⟫_ℂ := by
  simpa [cfc_toComplexMeasure, cfc_toLinearFunctional_apply, cfcCLM_apply] using
    (ComplexRMK.integral_rieszMeasure
      (compSL C₀((spectrum ℂ a), ℂ) C((spectrum ℂ a), ℂ) ℂ _ _
        (cfc_toLinearFunctional ha x y)
        (@ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ContinuousMap.liftZeroAtInftyCLE
          (spectrum ℂ a) ℂ ℂ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)
      ((@ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ContinuousMap.liftZeroAtInftyCLE
        (spectrum ℂ a) ℂ ℂ _ _ _ _ _ _) f)).symm

theorem complexMeasure_withDensity_ang_eq{α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : ComplexMeasure α)
    [SigmaFinite μ.var] : μ.var.withDensityᵥ μ.ang = μ := by
  change μ.var.withDensityᵥ (μ.rnDeriv μ.var) = μ
  have hμ : μ ≪ᵥ μ.variation := MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.absolutelyContinuous μ
  have hμ_parts : μ.re ≪ᵥ μ.var.toENNRealVectorMeasure ∧
      μ.im ≪ᵥ μ.var.toENNRealVectorMeasure := by
    rw [← ComplexMeasure.absolutelyContinuous_ennreal_iff]
    simpa [ComplexMeasure.var] using hμ
  have hre := SignedMeasure.withDensityᵥ_rnDeriv_eq μ.re μ.var hμ_parts.1
  have him := SignedMeasure.withDensityᵥ_rnDeriv_eq μ.im μ.var hμ_parts.2
  conv_rhs => rw [← μ.toComplexMeasure_to_signedMeasure]
  ext i hi : 1
  rw [SignedMeasure.toComplexMeasure_apply]
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [withDensityᵥ_apply (μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var) hi, ← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re,
      ← integral_re (μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var).integrableOn, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re,
      ← withDensityᵥ_apply _ hi]
    · change (μ.var.withDensityᵥ (μ.re.rnDeriv μ.var)) i = _
      rw [hre]
    · exact SignedMeasure.integrable_rnDeriv _ _
  · rw [withDensityᵥ_apply (μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var) hi, ← RCLike.im_eq_complex_im,
      ← integral_im (μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var).integrableOn, RCLike.im_eq_complex_im,
      ← withDensityᵥ_apply _ hi]
    · change (μ.var.withDensityᵥ (μ.im.rnDeriv μ.var)) i = _
      rw [him]
    · exact SignedMeasure.integrable_rnDeriv _ _

theorem complexMeasure_integral_indicator_eq_apply{α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : ComplexMeasure α)
    [SigmaFinite μ.var] {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.integral (s.indicator (1 : α → ℂ)) = μ s := by
  rw [ComplexMeasure.integral]
  have hpoint : (fun x => μ.ang x • s.indicator (1 : α → ℂ) x) = s.indicator μ.ang := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [hx]
  rw [hpoint, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hs]
  have hang := μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var
  have happ : (μ.var.withDensityᵥ μ.ang) s = ∫ x in s, μ.ang x ∂μ.var := by
    simpa only [ComplexMeasure.ang] using MeasureTheory.withDensityᵥ_apply hang hs
  calc
    ∫ x in s, μ.ang x ∂μ.var = (μ.var.withDensityᵥ μ.ang) s := happ.symm
    _ = μ s := by rw [complexMeasure_withDensity_ang_eq μ]

theorem cfc_toComplexMeasure_var_isFinite{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    (x y : H) : IsFiniteMeasure (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).var := by
  apply MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.mk
  unfold ComplexMeasure.var
  rw [MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.ennrealToMeasure_apply MeasurableSet.univ]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (cfc_variation_toComplexMeasure_bounded ha x y)
    (ENNReal.mul_lt_top enorm_lt_top enorm_lt_top)

theorem complexMeasure_norm_integral_sub_le_weighted{α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : ComplexMeasure α)
    (q : α → ℂ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q μ.var) {f g : α → ℂ}
    (hf : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z * (f z * q z)) μ.var)
    (hg : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z * (g z * q z)) μ.var) :
    ‖μ.integral (fun z => f z * q z) - μ.integral (fun z => g z * q z)‖ ≤
      ∫ z, ‖f z - g z‖ ∂(μ.var.withDensity
        (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ.ang z * q z‖)) := by
  rw [ComplexMeasure.integral, ComplexMeasure.integral]
  have hf' : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z • (f z * q z)) μ.var := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hf
  have hg' : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z • (g z * q z)) μ.var := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hg
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub hf' hg']
  calc
    ‖∫ z, μ.ang z • (f z * q z) - μ.ang z • (g z * q z) ∂μ.var‖ ≤
        ∫ z, ‖μ.ang z • (f z * q z) - μ.ang z • (g z * q z)‖ ∂μ.var :=
      MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ = ∫ z, ‖f z - g z‖ ∂(μ.var.withDensity
        (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ.ang z * q z‖)) := by
      let d : α → ENNReal := fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ.ang z * q z‖
      have hang : AEStronglyMeasurable μ.ang μ.var := by
        rw [ComplexMeasure.ang]
        exact (μ.integrable_rnDeriv μ.var).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hd : AEMeasurable d μ.var := by
        exact (hang.aemeasurable.mul hq.aemeasurable).norm.ennreal_ofReal
      have hd_lt_top : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.var, d z < (⊤ : ENNReal) := by
        filter_upwards [] with z
        change ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ.ang z * q z‖ < ⊤
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
      rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul₀ hd hd_lt_top]
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with z
      calc
        ‖μ.ang z • (f z * q z) - μ.ang z • (g z * q z)‖ =
            ‖(μ.ang z * q z) * (f z - g z)‖ := by
          congr 1
          simp only [smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        _ = (d z).toReal • ‖f z - g z‖ := by
          simp [d, norm_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

theorem complexMeasure_norm_indicator_mul_sub_le_weighted{α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : ComplexMeasure α)
    (q : α → ℂ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q μ.var)
    (hangq : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z * q z) μ.var)
    {w : Set α} (hw : MeasurableSet w) (h : α → ℂ)
    (hh : AEStronglyMeasurable h μ.var) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.var, ‖h z‖ ≤ D) :
    ‖μ.integral (w.indicator q) - μ.integral (fun z => h z * q z)‖ ≤
      ∫ z, ‖w.indicator (1 : α → ℂ) z - h z‖
        ∂(μ.var.withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ.ang z * q z‖)) := by
  let F : α → ℂ := w.indicator (1 : α → ℂ)
  have hind : w.indicator q = fun z => F z * q z := by
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ w <;> simp [F, hz]
  have hF_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable F μ.var :=
    (measurable_const.indicator hw).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hF_bound : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.var, ‖F z‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [] with z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ w <;> simp [F, hz]
  have hFi : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z * (F z * q z)) μ.var := by
    have htmp := hangq.mul_bdd hF_meas hF_bound
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using htmp
  have hhi : Integrable (fun z => μ.ang z * (h z * q z)) μ.var := by
    have htmp := hangq.mul_bdd hh hD
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using htmp
  rw [hind]
  simpa only [F] using
    (complexMeasure_norm_integral_sub_le_weighted μ q hq hFi hhi)

theorem complexMeasure_indicator_mul_of_continuous{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    (μ₁ μ₂ : ComplexMeasure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ₁.var] [IsFiniteMeasure μ₂.var]
    (q : X → ℂ) (hq : Measurable q) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ z, ‖q z‖ ≤ C)
    {w : Set X} (hw : MeasurableSet w)
    (hcont : ∀ h : C(X, ℂ), μ₁.integral h = μ₂.integral (fun z => h z * q z)) :
    μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)) = μ₂.integral (w.indicator q) := by
  let F : X → ℂ := w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)
  let ρ₁ : Measure X := μ₁.var.withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ₁.ang z‖)
  let ρ₂ : Measure X := μ₂.var.withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ‖μ₂.ang z * q z‖)
  let ρ : Measure X := ρ₁ + ρ₂
  have hang₁ : Integrable μ₁.ang μ₁.var := by
    exact ComplexMeasure.integrable_rnDeriv μ₁ μ₁.var
  have hang₁' : Integrable (fun z => μ₁.ang z * (1 : ℂ)) μ₁.var := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hang₁
  have hang₂ : Integrable μ₂.ang μ₂.var := by
    exact ComplexMeasure.integrable_rnDeriv μ₂ μ₂.var
  have hangq : Integrable (fun z => μ₂.ang z * q z) μ₂.var := by
    exact hang₂.mul_bdd hq.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure ρ₁ := by
    dsimp [ρ₁]
    exact isFiniteMeasure_withDensity_ofReal hang₁.norm.hasFiniteIntegral
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure ρ₂ := by
    dsimp [ρ₂]
    exact isFiniteMeasure_withDensity_ofReal hangq.norm.hasFiniteIntegral
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    infer_instance
  letI : ρ.WeaklyRegular :=
    Measure.WeaklyRegular.of_pseudoMetrizableSpace_of_isFiniteMeasure ρ
  have hF : Integrable F ρ := by
    dsimp [F]
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℂ)).indicator hw
  have hρ₁ρ : ρ₁ ≤ ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    exact Measure.le_add_right (le_refl ρ₁)
  have hρ₂ρ : ρ₂ ≤ ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    exact Measure.le_add_left (le_refl ρ₂)
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    rw [zero_add]
    obtain ⟨g, hgerr, hg_int⟩ := hF.exists_boundedContinuous_integral_sub_le (half_pos hε)
    let h : C(X, ℂ) := g.toContinuousMap
    have he_int : Integrable (fun z => ‖F z - h z‖) ρ := by
      exact hF.sub hg_int |>.norm
    have hleft :
        ‖μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)) - μ₁.integral h‖ ≤
          ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ₁ := by
      simpa [F, ρ₁] using
        (complexMeasure_norm_indicator_mul_sub_le_weighted μ₁ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))
          measurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable hang₁' hw (fun z => h z)
          h.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
          (D := ‖h‖) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm h)))
    have hright :
        ‖μ₂.integral (w.indicator q) - μ₂.integral (fun z => h z * q z)‖ ≤
          ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ₂ := by
      simpa [F, ρ₂] using
        (complexMeasure_norm_indicator_mul_sub_le_weighted μ₂ q
          hq.aestronglyMeasurable hangq hw (fun z => h z)
          h.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
          (D := ‖h‖) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm h)))
    have hleft' :
        ‖μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)) - μ₁.integral h‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ₁ := hleft
        _ ≤ ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ :=
          integral_mono_measure hρ₁ρ
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) he_int
        _ ≤ ε / 2 := by simpa [h] using hgerr
    have hright' :
        ‖μ₂.integral (w.indicator q) - μ₂.integral (fun z => h z * q z)‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ₂ := hright
        _ ≤ ∫ z, ‖F z - h z‖ ∂ρ :=
          integral_mono_measure hρ₂ρ
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) he_int
        _ ≤ ε / 2 := by simpa [h] using hgerr
    rw [hcont h] at hleft'
    calc
      ‖μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)) - μ₂.integral (w.indicator q)‖ =
          dist (μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ))) (μ₂.integral (w.indicator q)) := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]
      _ ≤ dist (μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : X → ℂ)))
            (μ₂.integral (fun z => h z * q z)) +
          dist (μ₂.integral (w.indicator q))
            (μ₂.integral (fun z => h z * q z)) := dist_triangle_right _ _ _
      _ ≤ ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using add_le_add hleft' hright'
      _ = ε := by ring
  · exact norm_nonneg _

theorem cfc_toComplexMeasure_indicator_mul_continuous{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    (g : C((spectrum ℂ a), ℂ)) {w : Set (spectrum ℂ a)}
    (hw : MeasurableSet w) (x y : H) :
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x ((cfcHom ha.isStarNormal g) y)).integral
        (w.indicator (1 : (spectrum ℂ a) → ℂ)) =
      (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral
        (w.indicator (fun z => g z)) := by
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x ((cfcHom ha.isStarNormal g) y)).var :=
    cfc_toComplexMeasure_var_isFinite ha x ((cfcHom ha.isStarNormal g) y)
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).var :=
    cfc_toComplexMeasure_var_isFinite ha x y
  refine complexMeasure_indicator_mul_of_continuous
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x ((cfcHom ha.isStarNormal g) y))
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y) (fun z => g z) g.continuous.measurable
    (C := ‖g‖) (fun z => ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm g z) hw ?_
  intro h
  change (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x ((cfcHom ha.isStarNormal g) y)).integral h =
    (cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y).integral (h * g)
  rw [cfc_toComplexMeasure_integral_continuous,
    cfc_toComplexMeasure_integral_continuous]
  rw [map_mul]
  rfl

theorem cfc_toComplexMeasure_spectralProjection_apply{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a)
    {w : Set (spectrum ℂ a)} (hw : MeasurableSet w) (x y : H) :
    cfc_toComplexMeasure ha ((spectralProjectionAux ha w) x) y w =
      cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y w := by
  let P := spectralProjectionAux ha w
  let μ₁ := cfc_toComplexMeasure ha (P x) y
  let μ₂ := cfc_toComplexMeasure ha x y
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure μ₁.var := cfc_toComplexMeasure_var_isFinite ha (P x) y
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure μ₂.var := cfc_toComplexMeasure_var_isFinite ha x y
  have hint (g : C((spectrum ℂ a), ℂ)) :
      μ₁.integral g = μ₂.integral (w.indicator (fun z => g z)) := by
    dsimp [μ₁, μ₂, P]
    rw [cfc_toComplexMeasure_integral_continuous]
    rw [spectralProjectionAux, InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply]
    simpa only [toBoundedBilin] using
      cfc_toComplexMeasure_indicator_mul_continuous ha g hw x y
  have hmain :
      μ₁.integral (w.indicator (1 : (spectrum ℂ a) → ℂ)) =
        μ₂.integral (w.indicator (w.indicator (1 : (spectrum ℂ a) → ℂ))) := by
    apply complexMeasure_indicator_mul_of_continuous μ₁ μ₂
        (w.indicator (1 : (spectrum ℂ a) → ℂ))

theorem Erdos757.diff_eleven_unique_nonsidon_triple{B : Finset ℝ} (hB : B.card = 4) (hdiff : (B - B).card = 11) : ∃! T : Finset ℝ, T ∈ B.powersetCard 3 ∧ ¬ IsSidon T := by

  have habvec : a -ᵥ b = (0 : ℝ) • (c -ᵥ a) + (-1 : ℝ) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    simp
  have hdbvec : d -ᵥ b = r • (c -ᵥ a) + (s - 1) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right d b a, ← hdrepr]
    module
  have hr_sign : SignType.sign r = 1 := by
    change (EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle (a -ᵥ b) (d -ᵥ b)).sign = 1 at habd
    rw [habvec, hdbvec,
      EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle_sign_smul_add_smul_smul_add_smul, hbasev] at habd
    simpa using habd
  have hr : 0 < r := sign_eq_one_iff.mp hr_sign
  have hcdvec : c -ᵥ d = (1 - r) • (c -ᵥ a) + (-s) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right c d a, ← hdrepr]
    module
  have hadvec : a -ᵥ d = (-r) • (c -ᵥ a) + (-s) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev d a, ← hdrepr]
    module
  have hsneg_sign : SignType.sign (-s) = 1 := by
    change (EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle (c -ᵥ d) (a -ᵥ d)).sign = 1 at hcda
    rw [hcdvec, hadvec,
      EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle_sign_smul_add_smul_smul_add_smul, hbasev] at hcda
    rw [show (1 - r) * (-s) - (-s) * (-r) = -s by ring] at hcda
    simpa using hcda
  have hs : s < 0 := by
    have : 0 < -s := sign_eq_one_iff.mp hsneg_sign
    linarith
  have hbdvec : b -ᵥ d = (-r) • (c -ᵥ a) + (1 - s) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right b d a, ← hdrepr]
    module
  have hrs_sign : SignType.sign (1 - r - s) = 1 := by
    change (EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle (c -ᵥ d) (b -ᵥ d)).sign = 1 at hcdb
    rw [hcdvec, hbdvec,
      EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle_sign_smul_add_smul_smul_add_smul, hbasev] at hcdb
    rw [show (1 - r) * (1 - s) - (-s) * (-r) = 1 - r - s by ring] at hcdb
    simpa using hcdb
  have hrs : r + s < 1 := by
    have : 0 < 1 - r - s := sign_eq_one_iff.mp hrs_sign
    linarith
  let q : ℝ := 1 / (1 - s)
  let t : ℝ := r / (1 - s)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - s := by linarith
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hqlt : q < 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [div_lt_one hden]
    linarith
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    positivity
  have htlt : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [div_lt_one hden]
    linarith
  have hqr : q * r = t := by
    dsimp [q, t]
    ring
  have hqs : q * (s - 1) = -1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    field_simp
  let x : ℝ² := AffineMap.lineMap a c t
  have hacne : a ≠ c := EuclideanGeometry.left_ne_right_of_oangle_sign_eq_one habc
  have hxac : Sbtw ℝ a x c := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [sbtw_lineMap_iff]
    exact ⟨hacne, htpos, htlt⟩
  have hxeq : x = AffineMap.lineMap b d q := by
    apply vsub_left_injective a
    dsimp [x]
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module', AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    change (t • (c - a) + a) - a = (q • (d - b) + b) - a
    rw [show d - b = r • (c - a) + (s - 1) • (b - a) by exact hdbvec]
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hqr, hqs]
    module
  have hbdne : b ≠ d := (EuclideanGeometry.right_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one habd).symm
  have hxbd : Sbtw ℝ b x d := by
    rw [hxeq, sbtw_lineMap_iff]
    exact ⟨hbdne, hqpos, hqlt⟩
  refine ⟨x, hxac, hxbd, ?_⟩
  have haxvec : a -ᵥ x = (-t) • (c -ᵥ a) + (0 : ℝ) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    change a - (t • (c - a) + a) = (-t) • (c - a) + (0 : ℝ) • (b - a)
    module
  have hbxvec : b -ᵥ x = (-t) • (c -ᵥ a) + (1 : ℝ) • (b -ᵥ a) := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    change b - (t • (c - a) + a) = (-t) • (c - a) + (1 : ℝ) • (b - a)
    module
  change (EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle (a -ᵥ x) (b -ᵥ x)).sign ≠ 0
  rw [haxvec, hbxvec,
    EuclideanGeometry.o.oangle_sign_smul_add_smul_smul_add_smul, hbasev]
  have hnegsign : SignType.sign (-t) = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  rw [show (-t) * 1 - 0 * (-t) = -t by ring, hnegsign]
  norm_num

theorem imo1984p5_intersecting_diagonals_ineq{a b c d x : ℝ²} (haxc : Sbtw ℝ a x c) (hbxd : Sbtw ℝ b x d)
  (hnoncol : (∡ a x b).sign ≠ 0) :
  dist a b + dist c d < dist a c + dist b d := by
  have hab : dist a b < dist a x + dist x b := by
    rw [dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff]
    intro h
    apply hnoncol
    exact EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mpr h.collinear
  have hsigncd : (∡ c x d).sign ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [haxc.oangle_eq_left_right hbxd] at hnoncol
  have hcd : dist c d < dist c x + dist x d := by
    rw [dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff]
    intro h
    apply hsigncd
    exact EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mpr h.collinear
  have hac := haxc.wbtw.dist_add_dist
  have hbd := hbxd.wbtw.dist_add_dist
  rw [dist_comm c x] at hcd
  rw [dist_comm x b] at hab
  linarith

theorem imo1984p5_convex_quad_diagonal_ineq{a b c d : ℝ²}
  (habc : (∡ a b c).sign = 1) (habd : (∡ a b d).sign = 1)
  (hcda : (∡ c d a).sign = 1) (hcdb : (∡ c d b).sign = 1) :
  dist a b + dist c d < dist a c + dist b d := by
  obtain ⟨x, haxc, hbxd, hnoncol⟩ := imo1984p5_convex_quad_crossing habc habd hcda hcdb
  exact imo1984p5_intersecting_diagonals_ineq haxc hbxd hnoncol

theorem imo1984p5_nonadjacent_card{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (i : Fin n) :
  (Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}).card = n - 3 := by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
    have hz1 : (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at hval
      omega
    have hneg1 : (-1 : Fin (m + 1)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at hval
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at hval
      omega
    have him1_ne_i : i - 1 ≠ i := by
      intro h
      apply hz1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_add_cancel] using congrArg (fun x : Fin (m + 1) => x + 1) h
    have hi_ne_ip1 : i ≠ i + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hz1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [add_zero] using h
    have him1_ne_ip1 : i - 1 ≠ i + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hneg1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
    have hcard : ({i - 1, i, i + 1} : Finset (Fin (m + 1))).card = 3 := by
      simp [him1_ne_i, hi_ne_ip1, him1_ne_ip1]
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff]
    · simp [hcard]
    · exact Finset.subset_univ _

theorem imo1984p5_nonadjacent_edge_double_sum{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
    (dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) + dist (P j) (P (j + 1)))) =
  2 * ((↑n : ℝ) - 3) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
  let e : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => dist (P i) (P (i + 1))
  have hsymm (i j : Fin n) :
      j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1} ↔
        i ∈ Finset.univ \ {j - 1, j, j + 1} := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    grind
  have hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, e j) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, ((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * e i := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, e j) =
          ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
            if j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1} then e j else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact (Fintype.sum_ite_mem (Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}) e).symm
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin n,
            if j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1} then e j else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin n,
            if i ∈ Finset.univ \ {j - 1, j, j + 1} then e j else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp only [hsymm i j]
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ {j - 1, j, j + 1}, e j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        exact Fintype.sum_ite_mem (Finset.univ \ {j - 1, j, j + 1}) (fun _ => e j)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n, ((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * e i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, imo1984p5_nonadjacent_card hn i]
  change (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, (e i + e j)) =
    2 * ((↑n : ℝ) - 3) * ∑ i : Fin n, e i
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, (e i + e j)) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, (((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * e i +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, e j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
        imo1984p5_nonadjacent_card hn i]
    _ = (∑ i : Fin n, ((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * e i) +
          ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, e j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = 2 * ((↑n : ℝ) - 3) * ∑ i : Fin n, e i := by
      rw [hsecond]
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (show 3 ≤ n by omega)]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring

theorem imo1984p5_shifted_diagonal_sum{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
    dist (P (i + 1)) (P (j + 1))) =
  ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j) := by
  classical
  let e : Fin n ≃ Fin n := Equiv.addRight (-1 : Fin n)
  rw [← e.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  dsimp [e]
  apply Finset.sum_bijective (fun j : Fin n => j + 1)
  · exact (Equiv.addRight (1 : Fin n)).bijective
  · intro j
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    grind
  · intro j hj
    simp

theorem imo1984p5_sum_nonadjacent_edge_ineq{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hquad : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
    dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) + dist (P j) (P (j + 1)) <
      dist (P i) (P j) + dist (P (i + 1)) (P (j + 1))) :
  ((↑n : ℝ) - 3) * (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1))) <
    ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j) := by
  classical
  have hnonempty (i : Fin n) :
      (Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1} : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mp
    rw [imo1984p5_nonadjacent_card hn i]
    omega
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
        (dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) + dist (P j) (P (j + 1)))) <
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
        (dist (P i) (P j) + dist (P (i + 1)) (P (j + 1)))) := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (hnonempty i)
    intro j hj
    exact hquad i j hj
  have hright :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
        (dist (P i) (P j) + dist (P (i + 1)) (P (j + 1)))) =
      2 * (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j)) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [imo1984p5_shifted_diagonal_sum hn P]
    ring
  rw [imo1984p5_nonadjacent_edge_double_sum hn P, hright] at hsum
  nlinarith

theorem imo1984p5_lower_ordered_sum{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1) :
  ((↑n : ℝ) - 3) * (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1))) <
    ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j) := by
  have hquad : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1},
      dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) + dist (P j) (P (j + 1)) <
        dist (P i) (P j) + dist (P (i + 1)) (P (j + 1)) := by
    intro i j hj
    have hj' : j ≠ i - 1 ∧ j ≠ i ∧ j ≠ i + 1 := by
      simpa using hj
    apply imo1984p5_convex_quad_diagonal_ineq
    · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hP (i + 1) j (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hj'.2.1) hj'.2.2
    · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hP (i + 1) (j + 1) (by
        intro h
        apply hj'.1
        have h' := congrArg (fun x : Fin n => x - 1) h
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using h') (by
        intro h
        apply hj'.2.1
        exact add_right_cancel h)
    · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hP (j + 1) i (by
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right, ne_eq, eq_comm] using hj'.2.1) (by
        intro h
        apply hj'.1
        have h' := congrArg (fun x : Fin n => x - 1) h
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using h'.symm)
    · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hP (j + 1) (i + 1) (by
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right, ne_eq, eq_comm] using hj'.2.2) (by
        intro h
        apply hj'.2.1
        exact add_right_cancel h.symm)
  exact imo1984p5_sum_nonadjacent_edge_ineq hn P hquad

theorem imo1984p5_cyclic_chord_lt_path{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1)
  (i : Fin n) {k : ℕ} (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n) :
  dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) <
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k,
      dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
  have hn1 : 1 < n := by omega
  have hkm1n : k - 1 < n := by omega
  have hstep : Fin.ofNat n k = Fin.ofNat n (k - 1) + 1 := by
    rw [Fin.ofNat_eq_cast, Fin.ofNat_eq_cast]
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkn]
    rw [Fin.val_add_eq_of_add_lt]
    · simp [Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkm1n,
        Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn1]
      omega
    · simp [Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkm1n,
        Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn1]
      omega
  have hk0 : Fin.ofNat n k ≠ (0 : Fin n) := by
    rw [Fin.ofNat_eq_cast]
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkn] at hv
    omega
  have hkm10 : Fin.ofNat n (k - 1) ≠ (0 : Fin n) := by
    rw [Fin.ofNat_eq_cast]
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkm1n] at hv
    omega
  have hpred : (i + Fin.ofNat n k : Fin n) - 1 = i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1) := by
    rw [hstep]
    abel
  have hjprev : i ≠ (i + Fin.ofNat n k : Fin n) - 1 := by
    rw [hpred]
    intro h
    apply hkm10
    have h' : i + 0 = i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1) := by simpa using h
    exact add_left_cancel h'.symm
  have hjcur : i ≠ i + Fin.ofNat n k := by
    intro h
    apply hk0
    have h' : i + 0 = i + Fin.ofNat n k := by simpa using h
    exact add_left_cancel h'.symm
  have hang := hP (i + Fin.ofNat n k) i hjprev hjcur
  rw [hpred] at hang
  have hnoncol : ¬ Collinear ℝ
      ({P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1)), P (i + Fin.ofNat n k), P i} : Set ℝ²) := by
    intro hc
    have hz := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mpr hc
    rw [hang] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hstrict :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) <
        dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1))) +
          dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1))) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) := by
    rw [dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff]
    intro hbtw
    apply hnoncol
    have hc := hbtw.collinear
    have hset :
        ({P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1)), P (i + Fin.ofNat n k), P i} : Set ℝ²) =
          {P i, P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1)), P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    rw [hset]
    exact hc
  have hof0 : Fin.ofNat n 0 = (0 : Fin n) := by
    rw [Fin.ofNat_eq_cast]
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.val_natCast]
  have hpath0 := dist_le_range_sum_dist (fun r => P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (k - 1)
  rw [hof0, add_zero] at hpath0
  have hpath :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1))) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k - 1),
          dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := hpath0
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k), Finset.sum_range_succ]
  norm_num [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k)]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hstrict (add_le_add_right hpath _)

theorem imo1984p5_offset_chord_sum_lt{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1)
  {k : ℕ} (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkle : k ≤ n - 2) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k))) <
    (min k (n - k) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
  have hkn : k < n := by omega
  have hklen : k ≤ n := by omega
  have hkforward (i : Fin n) :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) <
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k,
          dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) :=
    imo1984p5_cyclic_chord_lt_path P hP i hk2 hkn
  have hofNat_succ (r : ℕ) :
      Fin.ofNat n (r + 1) = Fin.ofNat n r + 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa only [Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Fin.val_add] using (Nat.add_mod r 1 n)
  have hshift (r : ℕ) :
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
    rw [hofNat_succ]
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_addRight, add_assoc] using
      (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight (Fin.ofNat n r))
        (fun i : Fin n => dist (P i) (P (i + 1))))
  have hshift_add (a : Fin n) (r : ℕ) :
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        dist (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n r))
          (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))) =

        _ = ((Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ
              Bandit.stepKernel alg ν k).map (Prod.map id Prod.fst) := by rw [h_joint]
        _ = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ alg.policy k := by
          rw [← Measure.compProd_map (by fun_prop),
            ← ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.fst_eq, Bandit.fst_stepKernel]
    let w : Set ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × (α × ℝ)) :=
      {x | x.2.2 ∈ s ∧ (x.1, x.2.1) ∈ v}
    have hw : MeasurableSet w := by
      exact (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter (hv.preimage (by fun_prop))
    have hstep (h : Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) :
        Bandit.stepKernel alg ν k h (Prod.mk h ⁻¹' w)
          = ν a s * alg.policy k h {b | (h, b) ∈ v} := by
      rw [Bandit.stepKernel, Learning.stepKernel, Learning.stationaryEnv_feedback,
        ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.compProd_apply (measurable_prodMk_left hw)]
      have hA : MeasurableSet {b : α | (h, b) ∈ v} := hv.preimage (by fun_prop)
      rw [← MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const, ← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator hA]
      apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr
      intro b
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft_apply']
      by_cases hb : (h, b) ∈ v
      · have hba : b = a := hva (h, b) hb
        subst b
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hb, w]
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hb, w]
    have heq :
        {ω | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩ f ⁻¹' v =
          (fun ω ↦ (Learning.hist k ω,
            (Learning.action (k + 1) ω, Learning.reward (k + 1) ω))) ⁻¹' w := by
      ext ω
      rfl
    rw [heq, ← Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) hw, h_joint,
      Measure.compProd_apply hw]
    simp_rw [hstep]
    rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul]
    · congr 1
      calc
        (∫⁻ h, alg.policy k h {b | (h, b) ∈ v}
            ∂(Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k)) =
            ((Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ alg.policy k) v := by
              exact (Measure.compProd_apply hv).symm
        _ = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map f v := by rw [h_f]
        _ = Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν (f ⁻¹' v) := Measure.map_apply hf hv
    · exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hv
  have hD : MeasurableSet (rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) :=
    hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hE : MeasurableSet
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) :=
    (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter hD
  have hsection (z : ℕ → α → ℝ) :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν
          ((fun x ↦ (x, z)) ⁻¹'
            ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
                Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
              rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u))
        = ν a s * Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν
            ((fun x ↦ (x, z)) ⁻¹' (rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u)) := by
    let vz : Set ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × α) := (fun x ↦ (x, q z)) ⁻¹' u
    have hvz : MeasurableSet vz := hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have hvza : ∀ x ∈ vz, x.2 = a := by
      intro x hx
      exact hua (x, q z) hx
    simpa only [f, q, rewardByCountFiniteData, Set.preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      Set.mem_inter_iff] using htraj vz hvz hvza
  unfold Bandit.measure
  rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm hE, Measure.prod_apply_symm hD]
  simp_rw [hsection]
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul]
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_right hD

theorem measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_top_slice{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (a : α) (n : ℕ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap (rewardByCountTopData a n) inferInstance]
      {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
        Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤ ∧
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} := by
  classical
  rw [← measurable_indicator_const_iff (1 : ℕ)]
  let k : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) →
      ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ)) := fun x =>
    (x.1, fun i b => if hi : i ∈ Finset.Iic n ∧ b = a then x.2 ⟨i, hi.1⟩ else 0)
  have hk : Measurable k := by
    unfold k
    refine Measurable.prod ?_ ?_
    · fun_prop
    · rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro i
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro b
      dsimp only
      split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  let φ : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) → ℕ := fun x =>
    if Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) x.1 = ⊤ ∧
        (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x)) ∈ t
    then 1 else 0
  have hprev : Measurable (fun x =>
      (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x))) := by
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro i
    exact (Learning.measurable_rewardByCount a (i : ℕ)).comp hk
  have hcond : MeasurableSet {x : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) |
      Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) x.1 = ⊤ ∧
        (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x)) ∈ t} :=
    ((measurableSet_singleton _).preimage
      ((Learning.measurable_stepsUntil a (n + 1)).comp measurable_fst)).inter
      (ht.preimage hprev)
  have hφ : Measurable φ := by
    unfold φ
    exact Measurable.ite hcond measurable_const measurable_const
  suffices {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
        Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤ ∧
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}.indicator
          (fun _ => (1 : ℕ)) = φ ∘ rewardByCountTopData a n from
    this ▸ measurable_comp_comap _ hφ
  ext ω
  have hv : (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) =
      (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ)
        (k (rewardByCountTopData a n ω))) := by
    funext i
    simp [Learning.rewardByCount, k, rewardByCountTopData, Finset.mem_Iic]
  simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, φ]
  simpa only [rewardByCountTopData, hv]

theorem measure_reserve_succ_inter_topData{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α}
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (u : Set ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ))) (hu : MeasurableSet u) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
          rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u)
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
  unfold Bandit.measure
  let X : (ℕ → α → ℝ) → ℝ := fun z ↦ z (n + 1) a
  let Y : (ℕ → α → ℝ) → (Finset.Iic n → ℝ) := fun z i ↦ z (i : ℕ) a
  have hX : Measurable X := by fun_prop
  have hY : Measurable Y := by fun_prop
  have hInd : IndepFun X Y (Bandit.streamMeasure ν) := by
    exact ((iIndepFun_eval_streamMeasure'' ν a).indepFun_finset₀ {n + 1} (Iic n)
      (by simp) (fun i ↦ Measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop))).comp
        (measurable_pi_apply ⟨n + 1, by simp⟩) measurable_id
  have hE : MeasurableSet
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
    exact (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter (hu.preimage (by fun_prop))
  have hB : MeasurableSet (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) :=
    hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
  rw [Measure.prod_apply hE, Measure.prod_apply hB]
  have hpoint (x : ℕ → α × ℝ) :
      (Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
          (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
            ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩ rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u))
        = (ν a) s * (Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
          (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u)) := by
    have hsec : MeasurableSet (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' u) := hu.preimage measurable_prodMk_left
    have hi := hInd.measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul s (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' u) hs hsec
    have hmarg : (Bandit.streamMeasure ν) (X ⁻¹' s) = (ν a) s := by
      rw [← (hasLaw_eval_eval_streamMeasure ν (n + 1) a).map_eq]
      exact (Measure.map_apply hX hs).symm
    rw [hmarg] at hi
    exact hi
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul]
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hB

theorem measure_rewardByCount_one_zero_slice{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α)
    (s t : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s} ∩
          ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
            {ω | Learning.rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}))
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              Learning.stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
            {ω | Learning.rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}) := by
  have h_left :
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s} ∩
          ({ω | stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩ {ω | rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}))
        = ({h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s} ×ˢ
            {z : ℕ → α → ℝ | z 0 a ∈ t}) := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hrs, hstep, hrt⟩
      have ha : action 0 ω.1 = a := by
        simpa only [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, false_and, true_and, false_or] using hstep
      have hr : rewardByCount a 1 ω = reward 0 ω.1 :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrs' : reward 0 ω.1 ∈ s := by rw [← hr]; exact hrs
      have hrt' : ω.2 0 a ∈ t := by rw [← hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨⟨ha, hrs'⟩, hrt'⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hrs⟩, hrt⟩
      have hstep : stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0 := by
        rw [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff]
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, ha⟩
      have hr : rewardByCount a 1 ω = reward 0 ω.1 :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrs' : rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s := by rw [hr]; exact hrs
      have hrt' : rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t := by rw [hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨hrs', hstep, hrt'⟩
  have h_right :
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
          {ω | rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t})
        = ({h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a} ×ˢ {z : ℕ → α → ℝ | z 0 a ∈ t}) := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hstep, hrt⟩
      have ha : action 0 ω.1 = a := by
        simpa only [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, false_and, true_and, false_or] using hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrt' : ω.2 0 a ∈ t := by rw [← hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨ha, hrt'⟩
    · rintro ⟨ha, hrt⟩
      have hstep : stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0 := by
        rw [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff]
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, ha⟩
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrt' : rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t := by rw [hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨hstep, hrt'⟩
  have hstep :
      (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (fun h : ℕ → α × ℝ ↦ h 0) = alg.p0 ⊗ₘ ν :=
    (Bandits.hasLaw_step_zero alg ν).map_eq
  have h_traj_s :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s}
        = alg.p0 {a} * ν a s := by
    calc
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s}
          = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (fun h : ℕ → α × ℝ ↦ h 0) ({a} ×ˢ s) := by
              rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) ((measurableSet_singleton a).prod hs)]
              rfl
      _ = (alg.p0 ⊗ₘ ν) ({a} ×ˢ s) := by rw [hstep]
      _ = alg.p0 {a} * ν a s := by
              rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod (measurableSet_singleton a) hs]
              simp
  have haction : (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (action 0) = alg.p0 := by
    exact (Learning.hasLaw_action_zero alg (stationaryEnv ν)).map_eq
  have h_traj_a :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a} = alg.p0 {a} := by
    calc
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a}
          = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (action 0) {a} := by
              rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) (measurableSet_singleton a)]
              rfl
      _ = alg.p0 {a} := by rw [haction]
  rw [h_left, h_right]
  unfold Bandit.measure
  rw [Measure.prod_prod, Measure.prod_prod, h_traj_s, h_traj_a]
  ac_rfl

theorem measure_rewardByCount_top_slice_previous{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
          {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤})
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
            {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) := by
  have hmeas := measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_top_slice a n t ht
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hmeas
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu_eq⟩ := hmeas
  have hA : rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u =
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) := by
    rw [hu_eq]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    exact and_comm
  have hevent :
      (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
            Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) =
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
    rw [hA]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hrs, hprev⟩, htop⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hprev, htop⟩
      rwa [Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop] at hrs
    · rintro ⟨hrs, hprev, htop⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, hprev⟩, htop⟩
      rwa [Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop]
  rw [hevent, ← hA]
  exact measure_reserve_succ_inter_topData alg ν a n s hs u hu

theorem measure_rewardByCount_finite_slice_previous{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n k : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
          {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)})
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
            {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)}) := by
  have hcomap := measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_finite_slice a n k t ht
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hcomap
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0, hpre⟩ := hcomap
  let u := u0 ∩ {x | x.1.2 = a}
  have hu : MeasurableSet u := by
    exact hu0.inter ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))
  have hua : ∀ x ∈ u, x.1.2 = a := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.2
  have hpre_u :
      rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u =
        {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)} := by
    rw [show u = u0 ∩ {x | x.1.2 = a} from rfl, Set.preimage_inter, hpre]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h.1.2, h.1.1⟩
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨h.2, h.1⟩, ?_⟩
      change Learning.action (k + 1) ω.1 = a
      exact Learning.action_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe (a := a) (m := n + 1) (n := k + 1) (by omega) h.2
  have hevent :
      (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
        {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)}) =
      ({ω | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) := by
    rw [hpre_u]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨?_, h.1.2, h.2⟩
      rw [← Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe h.2]
      exact h.1.1
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨?_, h.2.1⟩, h.2.2⟩
      rw [Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe h.2.2]
      exact h.1
  rw [hevent, ← hpre_u]
  exact measure_reward_succ_inter_finiteData alg ν a n k s hs u hu hua

theorem measure_rewardByCount_zero_slice_previous{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
          {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = 0})
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |

theorem measurable_maskReward{α R : Type*} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty R]

  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  intro j
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  intro b
  by_cases h : (j, b) = (k, a)

  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
    fun_prop

    intro b

    by_cases hjb : (j, b) = (k, a)

    · simp only [hjb, ↓reduceDIte]
      fun_prop
  have hc := h.comp hF (measurable_id : Measurable (id : R → R))
  simpa only [F, Function.comp_apply, id_eq, maskReward] using hc

theorem action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    {ω ω' : probSpace α R} (n : ℕ)
    (hhist : hist alg ω n = hist alg ω' n)
    (hfirst : ω.1 (n + 1) = ω'.1 (n + 1)) :
    action alg (n + 1) ω = action alg (n + 1) ω' ∧
      ∀ a, pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω =
        pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω' := by
  constructor
  · rw [congrFun (action_add_one_eq alg n) ω,
      congrFun (action_add_one_eq alg n) ω', hhist, hfirst]
  · intro a
    apply pullCount_congr (n := n)
    intro i hi
    have hpathω : (fun j : Iic n ↦ (action alg j ω, reward alg j ω)) = hist alg ω n := by
      simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω n).symm
    have hpathω' : (fun j : Iic n ↦ (action alg j ω', reward alg j ω')) = hist alg ω' n := by
      simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω' n).symm
    let j : Iic n := ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
    have hpair := (congrFun hpathω j).trans
      ((congrFun hhist j).trans (congrFun hpathω' j).symm)
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hpair

theorem selected_state_maskReward{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n : ℕ) :
    let a := action alg (n + 1) ω
    let k := pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω
    hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n ∧
      action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k := by
  dsimp only
  let a := action alg (n + 1) ω
  let k := pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω
  change hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n ∧
    action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
    pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k
  have hhist : hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n :=
    hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n k a le_rfl
  have hnext := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
  exact ⟨hhist, hnext.1, hnext.2 a⟩

theorem setReward_maskReward_original{α R : Type*} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty R]
    (k : ℕ) (a : α) (ω : probSpace α R) :

  · rfl
  · funext j b
    by_cases h : (j, b) = (k, a)
    · rcases Prod.mk.inj h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      simp [setReward, maskReward, rewardArrayOfWithout, rewardArrayWithout]
    · have h' : ¬(j = k ∧ b = a) := by
        intro hab
        exact h (Prod.ext hab.1 hab.2)

theorem selectedFiber_maskReward_iff{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n k : ℕ) (a : α) :
    (action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k) ↔
    (action alg (n + 1) ω = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω = k) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hc⟩
    have hhist : hist alg (setReward k a (ω.2 k a) (maskReward k a ω)) n =
        hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n :=
      hist_setReward_of_pullCount_le alg (maskReward k a ω) n k a (ω.2 k a) (by omega)
    rw [setReward_maskReward_original] at hhist
    have htransfer := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
    exact ⟨htransfer.1.trans ha, (htransfer.2 a).trans hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hc⟩
    have hhist : hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n :=
      hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n k a (by omega)
    have htransfer := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
    exact ⟨htransfer.1.trans ha, (htransfer.2 a).trans hc⟩

theorem map_restrict_preimage_of_indepFun{Ω β γ : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β}
    {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → β} {Y : Ω → γ} (h : IndepFun X Y μ)
    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) (s : Set β) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s)) =
      (Measure.map X (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s))).prod (μ.map Y) := by

  have hpre : (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ⁻¹' (s ×ˢ Set.univ) = X ⁻¹' s := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
  calc
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s)) =
        Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω))
          (μ.restrict ((fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ⁻¹' (s ×ˢ Set.univ))) := by rw [hpre]
    _ = (Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) μ).restrict (s ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (Measure.restrict_map (hX.prodMk hY) (hs.prod MeasurableSet.univ)).symm
    _ = ((Measure.map X μ).prod (Measure.map Y μ)).restrict (s ×ˢ Set.univ) := by rw [h]
    _ = ((Measure.map X μ).restrict s).prod (Measure.map Y μ) := by
      rw [← Measure.prod_restrict s Set.univ]
      simp only [Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ = (Measure.map X (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s))).prod (Measure.map Y μ) := by
      rw [Measure.restrict_map hX hs]

    intro ω hi hj

      _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>

        rw [← hμ]

    intro ω hω

    · exact hqX (measurableSet_singleton i)

      _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι => Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by

    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ =

    have hexS : Function.Exact

        (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl

        (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.map S f)) :=
      LocalizedModule.map_exact P.asIdeal.primeCompl _ _ hexS
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hexP]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hx : x = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hkiter x 0

        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl N ⧸
          LinearMap.range (LocalizedModule.map q.asIdeal.primeCompl f)) := by
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff]

    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hexP]

    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) P.toPrimeSpectrum

    unfold sigma
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact (Module.IsTorsion.finite_primeHeight_one_support hMT).union

      nofun

      rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, hpheight, hqheight])
    rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      ← PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff] at hmem

  have e_q : Nonempty
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M ≃ₗ[Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl]

    apply iterated_localized_map_bijective_of_comap S f P.toPrimeSpectrum
    simpa only [q] using hf

theorem primeHeight_comap_span_irreducible_localization_eq_one{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (sigma : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))

  (hn : sigma.Nonempty) (hfin : sigma.Finite)
  [IsDomain (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))]
  [IsPrincipalIdealRing (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))]
  (q : Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) (hq : Irreducible q) :
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) :=
    ⟨Ideal.span {q}, (PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hq).isPrime⟩
  (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) Q).asIdeal.primeHeight = 1 := by
  dsimp
  let R := Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
  let Q : Ideal R := Ideal.span {q}
  have hQmax : Q.IsMaximal := PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hq
  letI : Q.IsMaximal := hQmax
  letI : Q.IsPrime := hQmax.isPrime
  have hR : ¬ IsField R := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h.mul_inv_cancel hq.ne_zero
    exact hq.not_isUnit (isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨r, hr⟩)
  calc
    (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A R) Q).primeHeight = Q.primeHeight :=
      IsLocalization.primeHeight_comap (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl) Q
    _ = Q.height := (Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight Q).symm
    _ = 1 := IsPrincipalIdealRing.height_eq_one_of_isMaximal Q hR

theorem exists_isLocalizedModule_quotient_comap_span_pow{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (S : Submonoid A)
  (q : Localization S) (n : ℕ) :
  let Q : Ideal (Localization S) := Ideal.span {q}
  let P : Ideal A := Ideal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) Q
  ∃ g : (A ⧸ P ^ n) →ₗ[A] (Localization S ⧸ Ideal.span {q ^ n}),
    IsLocalizedModule S g := by
  dsimp
  let P : Ideal A := Ideal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) (Ideal.span {q})
  have hI : (P ^ n).localized' (Localization S) S
      (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S)) = Ideal.span {q ^ n} := by
    rw [Ideal.localized'_eq_map]
    rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    rw [IsLocalization.map_comap S (Localization S) (Ideal.span {q})]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_pow q n
  let f := (P ^ n).toLocalizedQuotient' (Localization S) S
    (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S))
  let eR := Submodule.quotEquivOfEq
    ((P ^ n).localized' (Localization S) S (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S)))
    (Ideal.span {q ^ n}) hI
  let e := eR.restrictScalars A
  exact ⟨e.toLinearMap.comp f, IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv S f e⟩

theorem Module.IsTorsion.isPseudoNull_of_primeHeight_one_support_empty{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
  (hM : Module.IsTorsion A M)
  (h : (Module.support A M ∩ {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}) = ∅) :
  Module.IsPseudoNull A M := by
  rw [Module.isPseudoNull_iff]
  intro p hp
  by_contra h2
  have hle : p.asIdeal.primeHeight ≤ 1 := by
    exact ENat.lt_coe_add_one_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge h2)
  have heq : p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1 :=
    le_antisymm hle (hM.one_le_primeHeight_of_mem_support p hp)
  have hp' : p ∈ Module.support A M ∩ {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1} :=
    ⟨hp, heq⟩
  rw [h] at hp'
  exact hp'

theorem exists_isLocalizedModule_pi_quotient_comap_span_pow{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (S : Submonoid A) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
  (q : ι → Localization S) (n : ι → ℕ) :
  ∃ g : ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) (Ideal.span {q i})) ^ n i) →ₗ[A]
      ((i : ι) → Localization S ⧸ Ideal.span {(q i) ^ n i}),

theorem primeSpectrum_comap_span_irreducible_mem_sigma{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (sigma : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))
  (hsigma : sigma ⊆ {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1})
  (hn : sigma.Nonempty) (hfin : sigma.Finite)
  [IsDomain (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))]
  [IsPrincipalIdealRing (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))]
  (q : Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) (hq : Irreducible q) :
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) :=
    ⟨Ideal.span {q}, (PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hq).isPrime⟩
  PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) Q ∈ sigma := by
  dsimp only
  let S : Submonoid A := ⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let R := Localization S
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum R :=
    ⟨Ideal.span {q}, (PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hq).isPrime⟩
  let P : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A R) Q
  have hPheight : P.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1 := by
    simpa only [S, R, Q, P] using
      (primeHeight_comap_span_irreducible_localization_eq_one sigma hsigma hn hfin q hq)
  have hdisj : Disjoint (S : Set A) (P.asIdeal : Set A) := by
    change Disjoint (S : Set A)
      (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A R) Q.asIdeal : Set A)
    exact (IsLocalization.disjoint_comap_iff S R Q.asIdeal).2 Q.isPrime.ne_top
  have hsub : (P.asIdeal : Set A) ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ sigma, (p.asIdeal : Set A) := by
    intro a ha
    by_contra hmem
    have haS : a ∈ S := by
      simp only [S, Submonoid.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff]
      intro p hp hap
      apply hmem
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem p (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hp hap)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj haS ha
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hle⟩ :=
    (Ideal.subset_union_prime_finite hfin hn.some hn.some
      (fun i hi _ _ => i.isPrime)).1 hsub
  have hEq : P = r := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    apply le_antisymm hle
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : P.asIdeal < r.asIdeal := lt_of_le_not_le hle hnot
    have hh := Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt hlt
    rw [hPheight, hsigma hr] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  simpa only [P, Q, R, S, hEq] using hr

theorem pi_prime_power_quotients_isTorsion{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
  [Module.Finite A M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion A M)
  {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum A)
  (hpM : ∀ i, p i ∈ Module.support A M) (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) :
  Module.IsTorsion A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha_ann, ha_nzd⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr
    (Submodule.annihilator_top_inter_nonZeroDivisors hM)
  have ha_ann' : a ∈ Module.annihilator A M := by
    simpa only [Submodule.annihilator_top] using ha_ann
  have hap : ∀ i, a ∈ (p i).asIdeal := fun i ↦
    Module.annihilator_le_of_mem_support (hpM i) ha_ann'
  let J : Ideal A := ∏ i : ι, (p i).asIdeal ^ e i
  let d : A := ∏ i : ι, a ^ e i
  have hdJ : d ∈ J := by
    apply Ideal.prod_mem_prod
    intro i hi
    exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hap i) (e i)
  have hJann : J ≤ Module.annihilator A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) := by
    rw [Module.annihilator_pi]
    refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
    exact le_trans Ideal.prod_le_inf (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hd_ann := hJann hdJ
  have hd_nzd : d ∈ nonZeroDivisors A := by
    apply Submonoid.prod_mem
    intro i hi
    exact Submonoid.pow_mem _ ha_nzd (e i)
  intro x
  exact ⟨⟨d, hd_nzd⟩, Module.mem_annihilator.mp hd_ann x⟩

theorem heightOneSupport_pi_prime_power_quotients_subset_range{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
  (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum A) (hpheight : ∀ i, (p i).asIdeal.primeHeight = 1)
  (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) :
  (Module.support A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) ∩
      {r : PrimeSpectrum A | r.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}) ⊆ Set.range p := by
  classical
  rintro r ⟨hrSupp, hrHeight⟩
  let J : Ideal A := ∏ i : ι, (p i).asIdeal ^ e i
  have hJann : J ≤ Module.annihilator A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) := by
    rw [Module.annihilator_pi]
    refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
    exact le_trans Ideal.prod_le_inf (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hJr : J ≤ r.asIdeal :=
    hJann.trans (Module.annihilator_le_of_mem_support hrSupp)
  obtain ⟨i, hiuniv, hi⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_le r.isPrime).1 (by simpa [J] using hJr)
  have hle : (p i).asIdeal ≤ r.asIdeal :=
    (Ideal.IsPrime.pow_le_iff (Nat.ne_of_gt (he i))).1 hi
  have hideal : (p i).asIdeal = r.asIdeal := by
    apply le_antisymm hle
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : (p i).asIdeal < r.asIdeal := lt_of_le_not_le hle hnot
    have hh := Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt hlt
    rw [hpheight i, hrHeight] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  have hpr : p i = r := PrimeSpectrum.ext hideal
  exact ⟨i, hpr⟩

theorem pi_prime_power_quotients_finite_torsion_support{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
  [Module.Finite A M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion A M)
  {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum A)
  (hpM : ∀ i, p i ∈ Module.support A M)
  (hpheight : ∀ i, (p i).asIdeal.primeHeight = 1)

    (Module.support A N ∩ {r : PrimeSpectrum A | r.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}) ⊆ Set.range p := by
  classical
  dsimp
  constructor
  · infer_instance
  constructor
  · exact pi_prime_power_quotients_isTorsion hM p hpM e he
  · exact heightOneSupport_pi_prime_power_quotients_subset_range p hpheight e he

  rw [Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.foldl_eq_foldl,
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.foldl_eq_foldl]
  change (m.alter k f).inner.inner.toListModel.foldl
      (fun acc q => acc + weight q) 0 =
    m.inner.inner.toListModel.foldl (fun acc q => acc + weight q) 0 + v * env k
  rw [fold_eq_sum, fold_eq_sum, hsumperm, list_lemma]

theorem affineMapEval_merge_add(p : ℕ) (x y : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  affineMapEval (x.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y) env =
    affineMapEval x env + affineMapEval y env := by
  have hmerge :
      affineMapEval (x.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y) env =
        affineMapEval (y.foldl (fun acc k v => acc.alter k (fun
          | none => some v
          | some u => some (u + v))) x) env := by
    unfold affineMapEval
    exact (treeMap_merge_add_equiv_foldl_alter p x y).foldl_eq
  rw [hmerge]
  have eval_updates (l : List (String × ZMod p))
      (acc : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) :
      affineMapEval
          (l.foldl (fun acc kv => acc.alter kv.1 (fun
            | none => some kv.2
            | some u => some (u + kv.2))) acc) env =
        l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) (affineMapEval acc env) := by
    induction l generalizing acc with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons kv l ih =>
      rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [ih, affineMapEval_alter_add]
  have foldl_add (l : List (String × ZMod p)) (a b : ZMod p) :
      l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) (a + b) =
        a + l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) b := by
    induction l generalizing b with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons kv l ih =>
      rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [add_assoc, ih]
  rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList, eval_updates]
  unfold affineMapEval
  repeat' rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList]
  simpa only [add_zero] using foldl_add y.toList
    (List.foldl (fun a b => a + b.2 * env b.1) 0 x.toList) 0

theorem affine_eval_add(p : ℕ) (x y : AffineExpression p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  (x + y).eval env = x.eval env + y.eval env := by
  change (x.offset + y.offset) +
      affineMapEval ((x.affine.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y.affine).filter (fun _ v => v ≠ 0)) env =
    (x.offset + affineMapEval x.affine env) + (y.offset + affineMapEval y.affine env)
  rw [affineMapEval_filter_ne_zero, affineMapEval_merge_add]
  ring

theorem affine_eval_mul_by_number(p : ℕ) (x : AffineExpression p) (n : ZMod p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  (mul_by_number x n).eval env = n * x.eval env := by
  unfold mul_by_number AffineExpression.eval
  change n * x.offset + affineMapEval (Std.TreeMap.filter (fun _ v => v ≠ 0) (Std.TreeMap.map (fun _ v => n * v) x.affine)) env =
    n * (x.offset + affineMapEval x.affine env)
  rw [affineMapEval_filter_ne_zero, affineMapEval_map_mul]
  ring

theorem affine_toConstant_eval(p : ℕ) (x : AffineExpression p) (n : ZMod p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  x.toConstant? = some n → x.eval env = n := by
  unfold AffineExpression.toConstant?
  split
  next hEmpty =>
    intro h
    have hn : x.offset = n := Option.some.inj h
    unfold AffineExpression.eval
    rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList]
    have hlistEmpty : x.affine.toList.isEmpty = true := by
      rw [Std.TreeMap.isEmpty_toList]
      exact hEmpty
    have hnil : x.affine.toList = [] := by
      cases hlist : x.affine.toList with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a l =>
        rw [hlist] at hlistEmpty
        contradiction
    rw [hnil]
    simp only [List.foldl_nil, add_zero, hn]
  next hNotEmpty =>
    intro h
    contradiction

theorem affine_mul_eval(p : ℕ) (x y z : AffineExpression p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  some z = mul? x y → z.eval env = x.eval env * y.eval env := by
  intro h
  unfold mul? at h
  cases hx : x.toConstant? with
  | none =>
      cases hy : y.toConstant? with
      | none =>
          simp only [hx, hy] at h
          cases h
      | some n =>
          simp only [hx, hy] at h
          injection h with hz
          subst z
          rw [affine_eval_mul_by_number, affine_toConstant_eval p y n env hy]
          exact mul_comm n (x.eval env)
  | some n =>
      simp only [hx] at h
      injection h with hz
      subst z
      rw [affine_eval_mul_by_number, affine_toConstant_eval p x n env hx]

theorem treeMap_listFold_alter_inner_eq(p : ℕ) (l : List (String × ZMod p))
  (x : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) :
  (l.foldl (fun acc kv => acc.alter kv.1 (fun
    | none => some kv.2
    | some u => some (u + kv.2))) x).inner.inner =
  l.foldl (fun acc kv =>
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter! kv.1 (fun
      | none => some kv.2
      | some u => some (u + kv.2)) acc) x.inner.inner := by
  induction l generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons kv l ih =>
    rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih]
    rw [treeMap_alter_inner_eq_alterBang]

theorem sorrydb_487083a0bf23b66f(p : ℕ) (e : Expression p) (ae : AffineExpression p) :
  some ae = AffineExpression.ofExpression? e → ae.eval = e.eval := by
  intro h
  induction e generalizing ae with
  | const n =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h
      funext env
      change n + 0 = n
      exact add_zero n
  | var x =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h
      funext env
      change 0 + (0 + 1 * env x) = env x
      simp only [zero_add, one_mul]
  | add e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h1 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e1 with
      | none =>
          simp only [h1] at h
          contradiction
      | some a1 =>
          cases h2 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e2 with
          | none =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              contradiction
          | some a2 =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              cases h
              funext env
              rw [affine_eval_add p a1 a2 env]
              rw [congrFun (ih1 a1 h1.symm) env, congrFun (ih2 a2 h2.symm) env]
              rfl
  | mul e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h1 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e1 with
      | none =>
          simp only [h1] at h
          contradiction
      | some a1 =>
          cases h2 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e2 with
          | none =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              contradiction
          | some a2 =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              funext env
              rw [affine_mul_eval p a1 a2 ae env h]
              rw [congrFun (ih1 a1 h1.symm) env, congrFun (ih2 a2 h2.symm) env]
              rfl
